Its flagship product, Justinian, is a legal AI agent that runs on roughly 157 billion records of American law and policy — including 13+ billion court records, every municipal code, and federal and state statutes, regulations, and active legislative sessions — planning research, drafting work product, and verifying and citing every claim against source. A second product, Trajan, is a government AI concierge for citizen services such as permits, registrations, and license renewals. Vulcan is FedRAMP Ready, runs in AWS GovCloud (US), and serves customers including the Virginia Office of Regulatory Management, the U.S. Department of Education, and South Carolina agencies. The company raised a $10.9M seed round (October 2025) co-led by General Catalyst and Cubit Capital, with participation from Y Combinator, SV Angel, and others. Vulcan is a product/agent company and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: IVIX
providers.description: IVIX is an AI-powered financial-intelligence platform that analyzes publicly available data at scale to surface hidden and unreported business activity, helping government tax authorities and law-enforcement agencies combat the shadow economy, tax evasion, and financial crime. The platform ingests open and third-party data to detect non-compliant businesses, quantify unreported revenue (including short-term rentals and crypto markets), and map illicit networks for enforcement teams. IVIX is a closed, government-facing product — it is sold and deployed with authorities rather than exposed as a public self-serve API — and it is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified for information security. Backed by Insight Partners; headquartered in New York with former IRS Commissioner Charles Rettig on its board of advisors.

providers.name: Linte
providers.description: Linte is a Brazilian legal-technology company offering an AI-powered contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform for large enterprises. Its product family spans Linte CLM for document automation and contract lifecycle governance, Linte AI for contract review that summarizes versions and flags risk against a customer playbook, Linte BI for contract analytics dashboards, and Linte Intake for legal demand intake and triage. The platform integrates natively with digital signature providers including ClickSign, DocuSign and D4Sign, and is sold to enterprise legal, procurement and compliance teams primarily in Brazil. Linte publishes no public API program, developer portal or API reference; its only public developer-facing artifacts are npm-published embeddable "Linte Docs" form components.

providers.name: Libryo
providers.description: Libryo (ERM Libryo) is a regulatory compliance management platform for Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) teams. It automates legal registers, streams site-specific regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, and tracks legislative change so that operators know which laws apply to each of their sites. Founded in 2016 with a distributed team across Cape Town, London, Toronto, Nairobi and Berlin, Libryo is now part of ERM, the sustainability consultancy. The product surface spans Libryo Sites (site-specific EHS regulatory intelligence), Libryo Assess (assessment and audit management), Libryo Collaborate, and custom legal registers, and is used in manufacturing, energy and utilities, chemicals, mining, logistics and telecoms. Libryo exposes a partner-facing RESTful API secured with OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow, documented publicly in the libryo/libryo-api-oauth-docs repository, and also offers its regulatory content as a data-as-a-service feed into third-party GRC platforms.

providers.name: Alma
providers.description: Alma is a technology-enabled U.S. immigration law firm for companies and individuals, combining licensed immigration attorneys with a platform that learns from every case it files. Alma takes end-to-end ownership of the employment-based immigration process — from initial assessment through approval — across temporary work visas (E-2, E-3, H-1B, L-1A, L-1B, O-1A, O-1B, TN) and employment-based green cards (EB-1A, EB-1B, EB-1C, EB-2 NIW, EB-2 PERM, EB-3). For employers it offers a case-management platform with real-time visibility, LCA/compliance tooling, spend forecasting, SSO, and HRIS/ATS integrations (Workday, ADP, BambooHR, UKG, and more). Alma publishes no public developer API; system integration is delivered through its enterprise plan on SOC 2 Type II infrastructure. This profile was surfaced via VC-portfolio discovery and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)
providers.description: The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), is a state statute that grants California residents rights over their personal information: the right to know, delete, correct, opt-out of sale/sharing, limit use of sensitive personal information, and non-discrimination for exercising privacy rights. It is enforced by the California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA) and the California Attorney General. Technical interoperability mechanisms include the Global Privacy Control (GPC) browser signal and the IAB Tech Lab US Privacy (USP) / Global Privacy Platform (GPP) signals for advertising technology. This index tracks the official regulatory resources, technical privacy signals, and commercial APIs that help businesses comply with CCPA/CPRA obligations.

providers.name: Chubb
providers.description: Chubb Limited is the world's largest publicly traded property and casualty (P&C) insurance company, serving consumers, small businesses, and multinational corporations across 54 countries and territories. Chubb offers commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance, and life insurance. The company manages more than $200B in global assets, paid $21B in claims (2023), and offers more than 200 insurance products and services. Key personal lines include homeowners, auto, valuables (jewelry, arts, wine), boat and yacht, pet (through a Healthy Paws partnership), and travel insurance. Commercial lines include small business, accident and health, commercial package, cyber, management liability, marine, professional liability, workers' compensation, and industry-specialty programs (construction, financial institutions, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing, real estate, technology, climate). Chubb Studio is the company's embedded insurance technology platform offering APIs and SDKs for partners to integrate Chubb insurance products into their own digital experiences.

providers.name: Firstbase
providers.description: Firstbase is an all-in-one startup operating system that helps founders form, run, and grow a US business from anywhere in the world. Its products cover incorporation (Firstbase Start for LLCs and C-Corps in Delaware, Wyoming, New York, Texas and more), ongoing compliance and registered-agent services (Firstbase Agent), bookkeeping, invoicing and tax-ready financials (Firstbase Accounting), tax filing, and a virtual business address (Firstbase Mailroom). Firstbase markets an embedded "Incorporation API" for platforms that want to offer company formation to their own users, but publishes no public developer documentation, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve developer portal for it. Firstbase is a venture-backed company (a16z portfolio) added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Flinn
providers.description: Flinn (flinn.ai) is an AI-powered regulatory and quality platform for medical technology and in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) manufacturers. It automates post-market surveillance (PMS) and compliance obligations across global frameworks including the EU MDR, IVDR, and FDA 21 CFR requirements. The platform continuously monitors 15+ safety databases in a single click, performs AI-assisted literature evaluation, automates complaint handling, and generates audit-ready reports for low- to high-risk medical devices. Flinn is used by 200+ global MedTech and IVD organizations, is hosted exclusively on AWS in Frankfurt (eu-central-1) with data kept inside the EU, and is validated/certified against ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/TR 80002-2, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, the EU AI Act, and GDPR. Backed by HV Capital and Speedinvest. This profile has been enriched from Flinn's public web presence; the product is a closed SaaS application with no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: International Trade Commission
providers.description: The United States International Trade Commission (USITC) is an independent, nonpartisan, quasi-judicial federal agency that fulfills a range of trade-related mandates. The USITC provides high-quality analysis of international trade issues to the President and the Congress, and serves as the primary forum for the adjudication of intellectual property and trade disputes. The agency exposes U.S. trade and tariff statistics through the USITC DataWeb interactive data service.

providers.name: Altana AI
providers.description: Altana is an AI-powered network for trusted trade, operating the world's largest knowledge graph of the global supply chain — a map covering roughly half of global trade and 600M+ companies, built from shipment and product information contributed by logistics providers and businesses. Altana connects enterprises, logistics providers, suppliers, and government agencies (including US Customs and Border Protection) around a shared source of product truth, delivered as Product Passports and the Atlas knowledge graph. Its solutions span trade and tariffs, sourcing and procurement, supplier management and screening, supply chain risk, regulatory compliance (UFLPA, EUDR, Section 889), and trade compliance. The Atlas Graph API (customer-provisioned, HMAC-signed API keys) exposes advanced searches across the Atlas knowledge graph, including notebook-based analysis in Databricks.

providers.name: Finrep
providers.description: Finrep is an AI-powered financial reporting intelligence platform for the office of the CFO. It helps SEC reporting, technical accounting, legal counsel, investor relations, disclosure committee, internal audit, tax, and ESG teams research, benchmark, validate, and draft SEC disclosures grounded in EDGAR filings, authoritative accounting guidance (ASC/IFRS), and IR materials — with every answer traceable to inspectable source documents. Finrep ships 40+ purpose-built CFO-office workflows spanning comment-letter analysis, disclosure drafting, Section 16 filing, and peer benchmarking, and can deploy on-premises or in a private cloud. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Ontic
providers.description: Ontic is a corporate and physical security management software company based in Austin, Texas, that unifies protective intelligence, executive protection, incident management, threat intelligence, corporate investigations, and Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) workflows into a single "Connected Intelligence" platform. Its software helps enterprise and government security teams detect threats earlier, coordinate response, run behavioral threat assessments and case management, and demonstrate measurable impact. Ontic serves Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies across government, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, financial services, pharma/biotech, tech/telecom, and media, and holds FedRAMP Moderate Authorization along with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and CSA STAR certifications. The product is delivered as a closed SaaS application (app.ontic.ai); no public developer API is currently published. Backed by Felicis.

providers.name: PermitFlow
providers.description: PermitFlow is an AI-powered construction permitting platform that simplifies permit preparation, submission, and tracking nationwide for contractors, home builders, commercial contractors, architects, developers, and home-services businesses. The product handles permitting paperwork across municipalities with AI agents for intake, research, submission, coordination, and issuance, and covers permit management, inspections and closeouts, and license and registration management. Backed by Accel, Felicis, and Initialized Capital, PermitFlow operates an internal product API (api.permitflow.com) and web application (app.permitflow.com) but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Risk Ledger
providers.description: Risk Ledger is a London-based third-party and supply chain risk management platform that helps organizations assess, monitor, and continuously manage the security risks across their supplier networks. Through its "Active Supply Chain Security" model and a connected network of 16,000+ organizations, suppliers complete a single standardized security assessment once and share it with every client, eliminating repetitive questionnaires. The platform maps supply chains from third through sixth parties, surfaces concentration risk, and delivers emerging-threat intelligence and breach monitoring with remediation tracking. Risk Ledger serves the public sector, critical national infrastructure, financial services and insurance, and technology sectors, and is ISO/IEC 27001 and Cyber Essentials certified. It is backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: Fenergo
providers.description: Fenergo is a financial services SaaS platform for Client Lifecycle Management (CLM), Know Your Customer (KYC), client onboarding, transaction monitoring, and regulatory compliance. The Fenergo SaaS Platform exposes API specifications across Entity Data, Journey, ETL, Data Migration, External Data, Policy, Legal Entity Screening, Risk, Event Notification & Ingress, Portal, Review Journey Scheduling, and Transaction Monitoring domains.

providers.name: Ontra AI
providers.description: Ontra is an AI-powered contract automation and digital execution platform for private markets. It automates routine legal and compliance workflows for investment firms, investment banks, and law firms, including contract negotiation, entity management (Atlas), in-house negotiation (Accord), automated due-diligence questionnaires (DDQ), investor obligation management (Insight for Funds), structured credit data (Insight for Credit), and reverse KYC services. The platform combines a global network of legal professionals with proprietary AI to summarize, search, compare, and surface data from legal documents, and exposes a read-only MCP server for real-time access to Atlas entity data. Ontra serves more than 1,000 firms including Blackstone, Bain Capital, AllianceBernstein, and Battery Ventures.

providers.name: OpenChain
providers.description: OpenChain is an international standard (ISO/IEC 5230) under the Linux Foundation for open source license compliance programs. It helps organizations manage open source licensing consistently by providing a benchmark for trust between organizations in the software supply chain.

providers.name: Sardine
providers.description: Sardine is a San Francisco-based fraud prevention, AML compliance, and risk management platform for fintechs, banks, marketplaces, and crypto VASPs. It unifies onboarding (KYC, KYB, document and bank verification), device intelligence and behavioral biometrics, payment and card fraud scoring, AML transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and case management into a single risk operating system. Sardine's "agentic" layer applies atomic agents (OSINT, data analysis, transaction monitoring, business due diligence, sanctions screening) to compress investigation time from days to minutes, while Sonar provides cross-industry fraud intelligence across the consortium. The platform serves 400+ enterprise customers including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Nubank, Novo, and bunq, has screened $1.3T+ in payments, and profiled 5.4B+ devices. Sardine has raised ~$170M from Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, Experian, Google Ventures, FIS, and others. Public docs cover the risk landscape and integration overview; full API reference, SDKs, and sandbox access are gated and require a Sardine account.

providers.name: Marlo Technologies
providers.description: Marlo is a maritime ERP platform for dry bulk, tanker, and commercial shipping companies, unifying chartering, voyage management, finance, banking, and compliance in a single system. Operators use Marlo to plan charters, track voyage operations and cargo, model voyage P&L and cashflow, run valuations and credit scoring, manage loans and covenants, hold multi-currency accounts with FX transfers and corporate cards, and handle sanctions screening, emissions tracking, and CII rating management. Marlo is a Techstars-backed company and holds SOC 2 (AICPA) certification. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this pass the company exposes a customer web application (app.marlo.co) but publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Relyance Ai
providers.description: Relyance AI is an AI-native data security, AI security, and privacy platform that maps data flows from source code through cloud and SaaS systems to AI models. Its core product, Lyo, acts as a "data defense engineer" providing real-time visibility into where sensitive data lives and moves, who accesses it, and how to remediate risk. The platform unifies data security (sensitive-data discovery, classification, and exfiltration detection), AI security (AI agent inventory, MCP server discovery, agentic AI risk), and privacy automation (DSRs, ROPAs, DPIAs, and consent management). Relyance AI is backed by Menlo Ventures.

providers.name: TermScout
providers.description: TermScout is a contract intelligence and certification company for legal, procurement, and sales teams. Its platform analyzes and benchmarks commercial agreements against market standards, generates contract signals through Certify (AI contract analysis), and certifies contracts with TrustMark as an external, third-party signal of fairness that helps buyers and sellers close deals faster with less negotiation. TermScout was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network. TermScout does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI; its products are delivered through the app.termscout.com web application. This profile captures the company's public web, trust, and security surface.

providers.name: Flow
providers.description: Flow (Flow Engineering, operated by TRC Space Ltd) is a requirements-management platform built for hardware and systems engineering teams. It centers on a Systems Graph that connects requirements, design artifacts, tests, and components, with AI agents that continuously align CAD, simulation, code, and test — automating impact analysis, budget tracking, and compliance checking. Flow supports branching and merging of requirement baselines, iterative build gates, and an integration ecosystem spanning CAD (Onshape, Fusion 360, Siemens NX), simulation (Ansys), and dev tools (GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Linear, Slack, Notion, Confluence). It is SOC 2 Type II, NIST 800-171, and ITAR/EAR aligned with self-hosted and AWS GovCloud options. A first-party API exists (referenced in the changelog) but is gated behind login with no publicly published OpenAPI or developer documentation.

providers.name: Proactis
providers.description: Proactis provides procurement and spend management solutions including purchase-to-pay, e-sourcing, contract management, and spend analytics software for organizations.

providers.name: Runharbor
providers.description: Harbor (Runharbor) is an AI-native contract research organization (CRO) and eClinical data management platform for clinical trials. Its software automates the core clinical-trial data lifecycle — study build, electronic data capture (eCRF/ePRO), source-document extraction, query generation, risk-based remote monitoring, electronic signature, and database lock — using AI to cut manual data entry and accelerate regulatory submissions. The platform is designed for 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, and ICH E6 (GCP) compliance, with per-trial database isolation and zero standing access to client data. Harbor is offered both as software (Magic Build, Magic Capture, Magic Monitor) and as full-service trial execution for sponsors and CROs. Founded in 2025 in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), Google Cloud, and the NVIDIA Inception Program.

providers.name: Remofirst
providers.description: Remofirst is a global employment platform and Employer of Record (EOR) that helps companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage full-time employees and contractors across 185+ countries without establishing local legal entities. Its services span EOR employment, international contractor management, global multi-currency payroll, health insurance (RemoHealth), visa and work-permit support, background checks, and workforce administration. Remofirst is backed by QED Investors and positions itself as a lower-cost alternative in the global HR and payroll category. It publishes no public developer API today; integrations are delivered through partner connections (BambooHR, ADP Workforce Now, GoCardless).

providers.name: Genie AI
providers.description: Genie AI is a legal-AI platform that helps business and legal teams draft, review, edit, and negotiate contracts autonomously. Founded in 2017 by founders trained by Google DeepMind, Genie is built on a patent-pending architecture called Eidetic Intelligence that gives its agents effectively unlimited memory across documents, negotiations, and organizational knowledge to reduce hallucination. The product ships autonomous contract drafting and review, multi-document deal management, risk analysis against organizational playbooks, tracked-changes negotiation, template automation, and one of the world's largest open legal libraries (500+ customizable templates and thousands of clauses across 150+ jurisdictions). Genie exposes an API and MCP connectors plus native integrations with email, CRM, cloud storage, and eSign on its Enterprise tier. The company is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 certified, does not train on customer data, and raised a Series A led by GV (Google Ventures) with Khosla Ventures.

providers.name: HireRight
providers.description: HireRight is a leading global provider of employment background screening, drug and health screening, and workforce verification services, helping more than 28,000 organizations across 200+ countries and territories run and manage their screening programs. Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, HireRight offers 250+ products and services spanning criminal, financial, identity, education and employment verification, compliance, driving records, and Form I-9 checks, and screened roughly 85 million people in 2025. HireRight does not publish a public developer REST API or developer portal; its integration surface is partner- and contract-based, delivered through 70+ prebuilt connectors with 45+ HCM and ATS partners (including Workday, ADP, Oracle, and UKG) and the Applicant Center candidate experience. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public, machine-readable, and security/compliance surface (llms.txt, trust center, disclosure, domain security) rather than an open API.

providers.name: Hyground
providers.description: Hyground GmbH (Hamburg, Germany) builds a sovereign, self-hosted AI SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) agent for European enterprises. The multi-agent platform deploys as a Kubernetes-native Helm chart inside the customer's own perimeter and correlates Kubernetes, observability (Prometheus, Loki, Elasticsearch), cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), CI/CD, and ticketing data to produce evidence-backed root cause analysis, autonomous incident response, and scheduled operations work such as CVE blast-radius mapping, RBAC drift audits, cluster right-sizing, and cost triage. It runs read-only by default, is bring-your-own-model (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Bedrock, Ollama), and keeps all data in-cluster with no external egress, targeting GDPR, BaFin, DORA, and NIS2 compliance requirements. Backed by partech; raised a EUR 3M pre-seed round.

providers.name: RapidClaims
providers.description: RapidClaims is a healthcare revenue-cycle-management (RCM) company building autonomous AI agents for medical coding and claims. Its platform automates medical coding (RapidCode), value-based-care coding and risk adjustment (RapidVBC), denial management and revenue recovery (RapidRecovery), and a unified revenue cycle platform (RapidRCM) for FQHCs, community health centers, ACOs, physician groups, ambulatory surgery centers, hospitals, and management services organizations. The company emphasizes a healthcare-grade security and compliance posture (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2 Type II, 256-bit encryption). RapidClaims is backed by Accel and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Afilio
providers.description: Afilio (Afilio - Gesellschaft für Vorsorge mbH) is a Berlin-based digital provision platform ("Vorsorgeplattform") that helps German families prepare for emergencies, care situations, and death. Through a paid membership, users create legally valid advance directives (Patientenverfügung), healthcare powers of attorney (Vorsorgevollmacht), and wills (Testament), and maintain a digital inventory of documents and assets. A central emergency card gives doctors and relatives 24/7 access to critical medical and provision information, and Afilio also assists with care-level (Pflegegrad) applications and expert consultation. Over four million families use the GDPR-compliant service. Afilio is a consumer (B2C) platform and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public product, legal, and security surface. Backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: Bonfire Interactive
providers.description: Bonfire Interactive is a strategic sourcing and procurement software company serving the public sector, based in the Kitchener-Waterloo region of Ontario, Canada. Its GoBonfire platform digitizes RFP/RFQ sourcing, bid evaluation and scoring, supplier management, and contract workflows for government agencies, education, healthcare, utilities, and nonprofit organizations. Bonfire was acquired by GTY Technology Holdings in 2019, and has since been consolidated — alongside IonWave, EqualLevel, and DemandStar — into Euna Solutions as Euna Procurement, a full-cycle public-sector procurement suite spanning sourcing, contracting, marketplace purchasing, invoicing, and supplier management. The gobonfire.com domain now redirects to eunasolutions.com. Bonfire does not publish a public developer API program or OpenAPI definition; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network completeness and demand tracking.

providers.name: Mirza
providers.description: Mirza is a public benefits infrastructure platform that helps government agencies, health plans and MCOs, health systems, and employers enroll people in social safety-net programs (Medicaid, SNAP, WIC, childcare subsidies, and more) and keep them covered as eligibility rules change. It matches individuals to 200+ benefits across all 50 states, verifies eligibility from existing data rather than paperwork, prevents disenrollment through early exemption detection, and generates audit-ready compliance documentation including H.R.1 Medicaid community-engagement support. Mirza integrates with existing eligibility systems rather than replacing them. Founded in 2020 by Siran Cao and Mel Faxon; backed by 500 Global and others.

providers.name: Parrot
providers.description: Parrot is an AI-powered legal technology platform purpose-built for the litigation, court reporting, and insurance community. Its proprietary large language models are trained on legal and insurance terminology to deliver audio/video-synced deposition transcripts, AI-generated deposition summaries (narrative, page:line, or topic-based), remote deposition scheduling and livestreaming, and AI-enabled medical record summaries with chronologies and source linking. Trusted by law firms, insurance carriers such as USAA and Travelers, and Fortune 500 corporations, Parrot operates under SOC 2, HIPAA, and HITECH controls. Backed by Amplify Partners and XYZ Venture Capital ($11M Series A, 2023); Parrot is now part of Filevine. Parrot is a product and services company; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: RBAC
providers.description: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) is a security paradigm that restricts system access based on assigned roles rather than individual user identities. Users are granted permissions through role membership, simplifying access management and ensuring the principle of least privilege. RBAC is foundational to enterprise identity, authorization, and compliance programs and is implemented across operating systems, cloud platforms, databases, and APIs. The NIST/ANSI/INCITS 359-2004 standard formally defines the RBAC model across four components: Core RBAC, Hierarchical RBAC, Static Separation of Duty, and Dynamic Separation of Duty. Cloud platforms (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM) and Kubernetes all implement RBAC natively, making it the de facto authorization standard for enterprise and cloud-native environments.

providers.name: AIS Group
providers.description: AIS Group is an analytics and investment management firm providing independent, data-driven insights across global financial markets. The firm combines macroeconomic research with quantitative analytics to deliver non-correlated investment strategies for financial advisors and institutional clients, with a focus on commodity, currency, equity, and fixed-income market analysis.

providers.name: Anduin
providers.description: Anduin (Anduin Transactions) is a private-markets technology company that digitizes investor onboarding and fund operations for venture capital, private equity, and hedge funds. Its platform replaces paper-based subscription workflows with electronic fund subscription documents, secure data rooms, investor data management, an engagement hub, an integration hub, automated data extraction, and e-signature. The company reports 1,305+ funds served, $244B+ capital raised, and 74,000+ investors subscribed. Anduin publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI; this profile captures its public company, trust, and security surfaces (Trust Center, RFC 9116 security.txt, and domain-security posture). Backed by 8vc; surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Playroll
providers.description: Playroll is a global HR platform providing Employer of Record (EOR), contractor management, and global payroll across 180+ countries. It runs local payroll, statutory benefits, and compliance for distributed teams, and offers a partner/enterprise integration surface - native HRIS connectors (HiBob, BambooHR), an "Open API" for bi-directional HR data sync, and custom/embedded integration builds. The developer API is partner- and enterprise-gated; sandbox access and documentation are provided to integration partners rather than published on a public developer portal.

providers.name: Geordie AI
providers.description: Geordie AI is an enterprise AI governance platform that gives organizations visibility into and control over the autonomous AI agents deployed across their environments. It discovers agents across code, cloud, endpoints, and SaaS; maps each agent's posture (permissions, tools, MCP connections, and system prompts); provides behavioral observability with continuous audit trails and anomaly detection; delivers risk intelligence mapped to standards such as OWASP, NIST, ISO 42001, and the EU AI Act; and offers Beam, a real-time remediation layer that applies deterministic controls at the agent level. Geordie raised a $30M Series A and is used by enterprises including Xapo Bank, Fitch Group, Synthesia, AlphaSense, Owkin, OakNorth, and A+E Global Media. The company is SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and GDPR compliant. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and General Catalyst and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Geordie publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Mabel
providers.description: Mabel is a healthcare technology company (Irvine, California; backed by 500 Global) that helps Medicare accountable care organizations (ACOs) enroll and engage beneficiaries. Its platform is a market leader in voluntary alignment, used by roughly one in three ACOs, and spans four core solutions: Voluntary Alignment (campaign execution, response processing, analytics, and compliance auditing for LEAD, ACO REACH, and GUIDE programs), Health Surveys (social determinants of health screenings, NPS, and custom surveys with CMS-formatted reporting), Beneficiary Notifications (compliance notices via email, mail, or SMS with audit-ready tracking), and Letters From Your Doctor (provider-based outreach for enrollment, surveys, and appointments). Mabel is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. No public developer API or SDK surface is published at this time; this profile captures the company's identity, compliance posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Vesence
providers.description: Vesence builds agentic AI for professional-services firms that works directly inside Microsoft Office. Its agents operate in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, plus a web app, reviewing emails, documents and projects before they leave the firm and turning Microsoft Word into a purpose-built workspace for high-stakes drafting, quality assurance and knowledge work. Vesence connects to SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Teams and document-management systems so agents work with a firm's existing files and context, with every edit traceable through tracked changes. Trusted by law firms, banks and investors, Vesence targets transactional legal work such as fund formation, M&A and corporate matters. It is a Y Combinator-backed startup surfaced through the venture portfolios of Creandum and Emergence Capital.

providers.name: Complir
providers.description: Complir is the AI infrastructure for product compliance, described by the company as "Vanta for physical products." Its AI agents map product data, analyse compliance risks, generate audit-ready documentation, and track regulatory changes across every market a brand sells in - covering GPSR, ESPR, EPR, REACH, RoHS, PPWR, EUDR, CE/UKCA marking, Digital Product Passports and 100+ other frameworks across 40+ markets. The platform maps each SKU to its regulatory requirements, produces translations, labels, warnings, declarations of conformity and technical files, verifies marketing claims, and offers native Adobe Illustrator/InDesign plugins plus a natural language interface for querying compliance data. Founded in 2024 (Gustav Bang, Marc Kaa Brejner, Tine Kuhnel) and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch, Complir monitors 100,000+ products for international retailers including Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Konges Sloejd, Matas and COOP.

providers.name: Fearn
providers.description: Fearn is the AI-native patent prosecution firm built for startups. It pairs former Big Law patent attorneys with proprietary, hallucination-resistant AI models built in-house by PhD computer scientists to take an invention from disclosure to a filing-ready provisional or non-provisional patent draft in minutes rather than the 50+ hours typical of traditional firms, at flat-rate pricing with automated labeled-figure generation and a money-back guarantee tied to claim allowance. Fearn self-hosts its entire AI infrastructure and uses no third-party model APIs, keeping invention disclosures confidential and compliant with SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and GDPR. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco; backed by Kindred Ventures and a16z speedrun. Fearn is a legal-services company and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Greenlite
providers.description: GreenLite Technologies is a construction permitting and plan-review platform that uses AI-powered technology and expert services to streamline building-permit approval for builders, developers, and jurisdictions. Its products include Atlas (a real-time permit tracking and management dashboard), LiteTable (AI-assisted plan review and code-compliance analysis), Private Plan Review (PPR), and Code Compliance & Pre-Check. GreenLite claims to reduce permitting timelines from 90-120+ days to 21-45 days and serves national QSR, retail, healthcare, education, and financial-institution brands. Backed by Craft Ventures and Insight Partners. GreenLite currently exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its company identity and security posture.

providers.name: Carbide
providers.description: Carbide (carbidesecure.com) is a compliance-automation and risk-management platform that pairs software with credentialed security advisors to help fast-growing organizations achieve and maintain security certifications and regulatory compliance. The platform automates evidence collection, maps controls across frameworks, tracks remediation tasks, surfaces compliance gaps, and continuously monitors cloud and business-tool integrations. Carbide supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, CMMC, CPCSC, GDPR, CCPA, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, PCI DSS, PIPEDA, and custom frameworks, and offers penetration testing and a customer-facing Trust Center product. Carbide is a Techstars portfolio company.

providers.name: Chainalysis
providers.description: Chainalysis is a blockchain analysis company providing data, software, and research to government agencies, exchanges, banks, and crypto businesses for compliance, investigation, and risk management. Core products include KYT (real-time transaction monitoring), Address Screening, the publicly hosted Sanctions API, Reactor (investigations and fund tracing), Crypto Investigations, Wallet Scan, Rapid (AI-assisted triage), VASP Risking, and Sentinel (stablecoin risk). Security-side products include Hexagate (web3 threat prevention) and Alterya (fraud prevention). Most APIs are REST-based and gated behind enterprise contracts, except the free public Sanctions Screening API.

providers.name: CyberGRX
providers.description: CyberGRX is a third-party cyber risk management platform — the Global Risk Exchange (GRX) — that helps organizations assess, monitor, and reduce risk across their vendor and supplier ecosystem. It combines a shared library of standardized vendor risk assessments with analytics for inherent and residual risk, control gaps, and findings. CyberGRX was acquired by ProcessUnity in 2023 and is now delivered as the ProcessUnity Global Risk Exchange. It exposes a versioned REST API (v1, bulk-v1, v2) authenticated with an account API token passed in the Authorization header, including a Bulk API that returns an entire third-party ecosystem — residual risk, control scores, and findings — in a single request, plus first-party Python examples and Go/Splunk connectors.

providers.name: Luminos.AI
providers.description: Luminos.AI is an AI governance and evaluation platform that tests AI systems — classical machine learning, generative AI, and autonomous agents — for legal, regulatory, and reputational risk. The platform automates continuous evaluations against customizable risks, generates privileged, audit-ready compliance documentation, runs approval and governance workflows, and monitors deployed models in real time for drift, updates, and deployment-context changes, all without requiring direct access to the underlying model. Luminos.AI was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and profiled into the API Evangelist network. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an OpenAPI definition; the product is engaged through hosted evaluations and demos.

providers.name: Echo
providers.description: Echo is a software supply-chain security company that delivers vulnerability-free (CVE-free), secure-by-design base container images, language libraries, hardened virtual machines, serverless runtimes, and OS packages. Its artifacts are built as drop-in replacements so engineering teams eliminate known CVEs across their software supply chain without changing application code, cutting remediation toil and easing compliance with frameworks like FedRAMP, FIPS, PCI DSS, DORA, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Echo operates as a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) and publishes a Trust Center with SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and FIPS 140-3 assurance. The company is backed by GGV Capital.

providers.name: Veratrak
providers.description: Veratrak is a supply-chain collaboration and visibility platform for the life-sciences and pharmaceutical industry. Its product, The Hub, aggregates external operations data from contract manufacturers (CMOs/CDMOs), third-party logistics providers (3PLs) and suppliers into a single, secure, compliant view covering batch status, inventory positions, production schedules, quality events and shipment tracking across a partner network. The Hub is format- and protocol-agnostic, exchanging data as CSV, XML, EDI or JSON over SFTP, AS2 or API, and offers API extensions that let pharma organisations connect internal systems to external suppliers with minimal IT effort. The platform is ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certified and GDPR compliant. Veratrak is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

providers.name: ankar.ai
providers.description: Ankar is an AI operating system built for patent professionals, covering the full patent lifecycle: idea generation and patentability assessment, drafting of invention disclosures and applications, prosecution including office-action responses and strategy, and protection through infringement monitoring and competitive intelligence. It also provides small-molecule and sequence analysis, claim charts, research intelligence, and traceable citations to guidelines and case law. Customers are patent law firms and in-house IP teams (AmLaw 100 firms and Fortune 500 corporations), with 1,000+ users. Ankar is SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001:2022 certified and does not train AI models on customer data. It is enterprise-sold (book-a-demo) and publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Bretton AI
providers.description: Bretton AI (formerly Greenlite AI) is an AI-native operations platform for the financial back office, providing audit-ready agentic AI that staffs regulated financial-crime compliance work for banks and fintechs. Its agents automate AML alert investigation, KYC/CDD/EDD reviews, sanctions screening, and ongoing transaction monitoring inside existing systems, pairing large language models with a proprietary Trust Infrastructure layer that enforces deterministic compliance rules, audit logging, model risk management, and 100% traceability for BSA/AML audits. The platform ships pre-built skill templates with 180+ data-source connectors, a natural-language agent Builder, and a collaborative human-AI Workbench, integrating with 25+ enterprise systems including Salesforce, Oracle, nCino, ServiceNow, FICO, and Actimize. Bretton is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant, backed by Greylock and Sapphire Ventures (Series B, 2026). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from the Greylock portfolio; the company exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: DigitalOwl
providers.description: DigitalOwl is an AI-powered platform that transforms unstructured medical records into structured, actionable data for the life insurance, property & casualty insurance, and legal industries. Its products (View, Triage, Connect, Chat, Workflows, and Case Notes) automate medical record review, summarization, triage, and data extraction to accelerate underwriting, claims processing, and legal demand-package analysis. The Connect Data API maps source documents, classifications, and medical mentions (conditions, procedures, medications) into structured layers for integration into existing carrier and law-firm systems. DigitalOwl operates on AWS and Google Cloud with SOC 2 (Type II), HIPAA, and GDPR compliance. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Siteline
providers.description: Siteline is billing and accounts receivable software built specifically for commercial subcontractors (trade contractors). It centralizes pay applications (including AIA G702/G703 progress billing), lien waivers, lien rights, compliance documents, change orders, collections, and A/R reporting in one workflow, replacing the spreadsheets, PDFs, and GC payment-portal logins that AP/AR teams juggle every month. Siteline integrates with construction accounting systems (Sage, Foundation, Viewpoint/Vista, Spectrum, QuickBooks, Acumatica, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, CMiC, and others) and with GC payment portals (Textura, GCPay, Procore Pay) so billing data flows without double entry. Founded in 2019 by Claire Wilson and Gloria Lin, backed by Menlo Ventures and First Round Capital; subcontractors have billed over $10B across 200,000+ projects on the platform. Siteline publishes no public developer API — integrations are managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Tradespace
providers.description: Tradespace is an AI-powered intellectual property management platform that combines IP management software, AI tooling, and on-demand patent attorneys in a single full-service patent practice. The platform spans the IP lifecycle across four products — Create (invention harvesting and disclosure, with Slack, Gmail, and Notion integrations), Protect (AI-assisted patent drafting and flat-fee prosecution with senior attorneys), Manage (portfolio management and board-ready reporting), and Commercialize (licensing campaigns, claims charts, and licensee identification). It serves corporations, universities, tech transfer offices, startups, law firms, and government agencies, is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant (Vanta trust center), hosts on Microsoft Azure with customer-private AI instances, and is a 500 Global portfolio company. The SaaS application runs at app.tradespace.io; no public developer API is published.

providers.name: Chaoslabs
providers.description: Chaos Labs is a New York-based company building financial-intelligence and economic-security infrastructure for onchain markets. Its flagship product, Edge (Chaos Oracles), is a decentralized oracle protocol that unifies real-time price, risk, and proof-of-reserves data, delivering high-precision price feeds with an integrated risk engine plus automated, real-time risk-parameter optimization. Leading DeFi protocols including Aave, GMX, dYdX, Jupiter, Venus, Lido, Maker and Uniswap Foundation use Chaos Labs to help secure billions of dollars in value. Developer integration spans EVM, SVM, off-chain services and TradingView via docs.chaoslabs.xyz. Founded in 2021 by Omer Goldberg and Julian Lindinger, Chaos Labs is backed by Haun Ventures, Galaxy, PayPal Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Lightspeed, Bessemer and others, and holds ISO/IEC 27001 certification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched from Chaos Labs' real public developer surface.

providers.name: Conductor AI
providers.description: Conductor AI (ConductorAI) is a defense- and intelligence-focused artificial intelligence company that turns disparate policy documents and organizational knowledge into agentic decision trees to accelerate document approvals and complex regulated workflows. Its Conduit platform combines agentic search across structured and unstructured data (Office documents, HTML, images, and video), workflow orchestration that encodes policy and expertise into AI-augmented decision steps, and review-and-collaboration tooling for redactions and compliance checks. Applications include ITAR/EAR export-control review, e-discovery and investigations, security-classification review, FOIA processing, and foreign-disclosure decisions. Conductor AI serves U.S. government and commercial customers and is backed by Lux Capital and Andreessen Horowitz. The company exposes no public developer API; integration is delivered as an enterprise platform.

providers.name: Greenboard
providers.description: Greenboard is an AI-native compliance software platform for SEC- and FINRA-regulated financial institutions, consolidating communications archiving, employee compliance monitoring, marketing/advertising review, firm-wide compliance management, and third-party (vendor) compliance into a single system of action. It serves independent advisors, RIAs, hedge funds, private funds, and broker-dealers, automating regulatory workflows and reducing review times. Greenboard is a General Catalyst portfolio company. Its product is delivered as a hosted SaaS application; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published at this time, so this profile captures corporate identity, trust/compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II), and domain security rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Hadrius
providers.description: Hadrius is an AI-native compliance platform for SEC- and FINRA-regulated financial firms, including broker-dealers, registered investment advisors (RIAs), private funds, and compliance consultants. The platform consolidates multiple compliance functions into a single system of record with human governance: a testing program that automates compliance testing and audit reporting, AI-powered marketing review and content approval workflows, people oversight for personal trading, attestations and certifications, communications archiving that supervises email, chat, and social media with zero-retention AI, and account surveillance that monitors trades against restricted lists and blackout windows. Hadrius serves 500+ institutions managing over $5 trillion in AUM, raised a $22M Series A, and is backed by Y Combinator and CRV. The company is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant. This profile currently documents no public developer API; it is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: SunGard Data Systems
providers.description: SunGard Data Systems was a software and technology services company that provided software and processing solutions to financial services, education, and the public sector. In November 2015, SunGard was acquired by Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) for approximately $9.1 billion. Key product lines included SunGard Financial Systems (trading, treasury, risk management, capital markets), SunGard AvantGard (cash and liquidity management), SunGard K-12 (student information systems), and SunGard Higher Education (ERP for universities). Post-acquisition, these products were integrated into the FIS portfolio.

providers.name: Strongkeep
providers.description: StrongKeep is a cybersecurity platform built for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) that lack a dedicated IT team or a large security budget. It bundles malware protection, scam and phishing protection, security-awareness ("secure habits") training, human-risk monitoring, and compliance readiness (such as Cyber Essentials) into a single dashboard, with most customers reportedly going live within 60 minutes. StrongKeep offers a free no-install security scan, plans starting at $39/month, and vertical solutions for healthcare clinics and professional-services firms. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. StrongKeep does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from its public web surface (identity, security.txt, and domain-security probes).

providers.name: Zinc
providers.description: Zinc is a UK-founded, Y Combinator and Seedcamp-backed background checking platform that automates pre-employment screening for HR and talent teams. It runs criminal record checks across 195 countries, employment and reference verification, financial and adverse-media screening, right-to-work and qualification checks, delivering results in hours rather than weeks with an average three-day turnaround. Zinc integrates with major ATS and HRIS platforms (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, HiBob, SAP SuccessFactors and others) and is ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials, GDPR and FCRA aligned. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched from Zinc's public web surface; no public developer API or OpenAPI specification is published at this time.

providers.name: Aatmunn
providers.description: Aatmunn (formerly Guardhat, founded 2014 in Detroit and headquartered in Livonia, Michigan) is an industrial safety and asset intelligence platform for frontline and deskless workers. Its SPANR / Industrial Internet of People (IIoP) platform unifies workers, workplaces, and assets into one real-time system, connecting devices from any manufacturer and layering AI-driven insights for predictive hazard detection, emergency response, inspections, and compliance. Products include Inspections, Lone Worker Safety, Human Condition Monitoring, Gas Detection, Control Access Zoning, and Asset Tracking, serving 250+ companies across high-risk industries such as oil & gas, chemicals, mining & infrastructure, manufacturing, utilities, and warehousing & logistics. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and is maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; Aatmunn publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Hummingbird
providers.description: Hummingbird is an AI-powered compliance operations platform for financial institutions and fintechs. It automates customer screening (sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media checks), transaction monitoring for financial crime, investigations and case management, and regulatory reporting including automated SAR, STR, and CTR filing. Hummingbird orchestrates risk and anti-money-laundering (AML) workflows across a connected app marketplace of 50+ integrations, and exposes custom two-way integration APIs provisioned through its partnerships team. The company is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified and backed by Homebrew.

providers.name: LifeSite
providers.description: LifeSite is a data protection and digital asset company that helps organizations safeguard sensitive information, simplify compliance, and digitally verify ownership. Its Vault product is an encrypted store for personally identifiable, financial, and health information used by both enterprises and families to organize and collaborate on vital documents. TokenX, its Web3 arm, tokenizes real-world assets — critical minerals, carbon credits, and sports and consumer goods — so provenance and ownership can be authenticated without blockchain expertise. A Wellness product covers health, testing, and vaccination tracking for enterprises and events, and a Platform offering exposes LifeSite's building blocks and APIs for partners building tailored data-management applications. LifeSite is sales-led: the Platform APIs are described publicly but no developer portal, API reference, or specification is published, and access is arranged through a demo request.

providers.name: Litify
providers.description: Litify is a legal operating system built on Salesforce that provides REST APIs for managing matters, intakes, documents, tasks, time tracking, billing, and client communications for law firms and legal departments. Integrators access Litify functionality via the Salesforce REST API and the Litify Docrio API under the terms of the Litify API Integration Agreement.

providers.name: Standard Operating Procedures
providers.description: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are documented step-by-step instructions for routine operations and processes to ensure consistency, quality, and compliance across an organization. They are essential for regulated industries such as healthcare, pharmaceuticals, finance, food service, aviation, and manufacturing. SOPs establish clear responsibilities, document institutional knowledge, support regulatory compliance, enable process auditing, and facilitate employee onboarding. Software platforms for SOP management include SweetProcess, Trainual, Guru, Document360, and Notion; many offer developer APIs for embedding SOP workflows into other business systems.

providers.name: Supio
providers.description: Supio is an agentic legal AI platform built for plaintiff and personal-injury law firms, supporting a case from intake to verdict. Its Supio Agent automates labor-intensive legal work — case intake, medical-record analysis and medical chronologies (MedChrons), demand-letter drafting, case-economics analysis, and litigation document drafting — and adds firm-level intelligence across cases. Supio publishes no public developer portal or OpenAPI, but offers a customer-available API for building custom integrations, dashboards, and workflows on the structured case data it generates, and integrates with case management systems (Litify, SmartAdvocate, CasePeer, MyCase, Smokeball), document stores (Box, Dropbox, OneDrive, SharePoint), and Westlaw via a Thomson Reuters partnership. The platform is SOC 2 Type II certified and HIPAA, PHIPA, and GDPR compliant.

providers.name: Accordance Ai
providers.description: Accordance (operated by Agnetic Labs Inc.) is a San Francisco frontier AI platform built for tax, audit, and accounting professionals. Founded by researchers from the Stanford AI Lab, it provides a firmwide agentic AI platform that performs tax research with authoritative code, context, and citations, complex accounting analysis, and audit insight — with visible reasoning and verifiable source citations. Accordance is SOC 2 Type II certified, never trains on customer data, and is backed by Menlo Ventures, Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and New Enterprise Associates. The product surface is the Accordance application (app.accordance.ai); no public developer API is currently documented.

providers.name: Case Status
providers.description: Case Status is a Charleston, South Carolina legal technology company, founded in 2018 by Andy Seavers and Lauren Gulley, that builds an AI-powered client engagement, experience, and communication platform for modern law firms. It delivers a branded, mobile-first client portal (iOS and Android), a CMS-integrated secure messaging hub with 1:1, bulk, and automated options, AI-driven Client Intelligence (message urgency triage, response recommendations, case summarization, sentiment prediction, and translation across 140+ languages), and client satisfaction analytics such as NPS, Predictive NPS, and CSAT. Case Status integrates with leading case management systems including Clio, Litify, MyCase, Neos, Filevine, SmartAdvocate, Docketwise, PracticePanther, SmokeBall, CASEpeer, MerusCase, CoCounselor, Salesforce, NuLaw, Matterly, and Zapier, plus a Chrome extension for attorneys. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars.

providers.name: Lawhive
providers.description: Lawhive is a UK consumer legal-services marketplace that connects individuals and small businesses with regulated solicitors online at fixed, transparent prices, positioned as roughly half the cost of a traditional high-street law firm. Clients answer intake questions on the site, receive a quote or a callback, and are matched with a vetted consultant lawyer who then runs the matter end to end through the Lawhive platform, covering conveyancing, divorce and family, employment, immigration, landlord and tenant, and property work. Lawhive Ltd is not a law firm and does not give legal advice itself; regulated legal services are delivered by its network, including affiliate firm Lawhive Legal Ltd, which is authorised and regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA ID 8003766). The company is backed by Balderton Capital and GV. Lawhive publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation, so this profile captures its identity, legal and compliance posture, and probed domain-security surface rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Second Front Systems
providers.description: Second Front Systems is a public-benefit, venture-backed software company that accelerates government access to emerging technologies for the world's democracies. Its 2F Suite delivers DevSecOps and continuous-accreditation tooling for defense and public-sector software teams: 2F Workshop (integrated security and compliance tooling for accredited development), 2F Game Warden (a fully accredited FedRAMP High and DoD ATO DevSecOps platform that fast-tracks commercial software to classified and unclassified government networks in roughly 90 days), and 2F Frontier (edge deployment to disconnected and denied environments). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It exposes no public developer API; its primary technical surface is the Game Warden platform documentation, a compliance Trust Center, and a broad certification posture (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, FIPS 140).

providers.name: Trustdock
providers.description: TRUSTDOCK Inc. (株式会社TRUSTDOCK) is a Tokyo-based digital identity and eKYC (electronic Know Your Customer) provider founded in November 2017. The company delivers high-precision, fast, and low-cost online identity verification and digital ID infrastructure via API, serving more than 300 enterprise and government clients across finance, insurance, ride-sharing and car-sharing, telecommunications (MNO/MVNO), real-estate crowdfunding, second-hand/reuse goods, recruitment, matching apps, and public-sector onboarding. TRUSTDOCK offers both browser-based and mobile-app-based verification flows, holds ISMS (ISO 27001) certification and the Japanese PrivacyMark, and participates in the OpenID Foundation Japan KYC Working Group and the FIDO Alliance. Its API documentation is provided to customers under NDA rather than published to a public developer portal.

providers.name: Accordance
providers.description: Accordance (Agnetic Labs Inc.) is a San Francisco-based artificial intelligence company building a frontier research platform for tax, audit, and accounting professionals. Founded by Stanford AI Lab researchers, its multi-agent AI helps CPAs and tax teams navigate regulations, conduct authoritative research, and deliver advice with visible reasoning and cited sources, backed by real-time regulatory updates, project-based context management, and enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 Type II). Accordance is venture-backed by Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and New Enterprise Associates. It is a product-led SaaS application with no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: LegalOS
providers.description: LegalOS is an AI-native U.S. immigration law practice based in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Founded by Matthew Asir (CEO), Rachel Asir (COO) and Claire Jutabha (CTO), the company pairs proprietary legal software with licensed immigration attorneys to prepare employment-based visa and green-card petitions — H-1B, L-1A, L-1B, O-1 and TN visas, plus EB-1A, EB-1C and EB-2 NIW green cards. AI agents draft petition narratives, assemble supporting evidence and anticipate USCIS objections, with every filing reviewed by a licensed attorney before submission. LegalOS is delivered as a service through a customer web application at app.legalos.ai; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, developer portal or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Secureframe
providers.description: Secureframe automates security and privacy compliance for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIST, and more. The Secureframe Public API exposes controls, frameworks, evidence, tests, personnel, and vendor data.

providers.name: Caya
providers.description: Caya (Caya GmbH, Berlin) is a German intelligent document processing (IDP) company whose Document Automation Suite digitizes, classifies, and routes business documents end to end. Its core capabilities are Post Scan (physical mail intake with OCR and automatic classification), Document Extractions (AI-powered structured data extraction), and Document Automations (rule-based routing and distribution into downstream systems). Caya connects to 100+ tools across accounting, ERP, HR, cloud storage, and e-signature, and hosts data in a high-security Frankfurt data center. It is certified and compliant against ISO 27001, GDPR/DSGVO, DORA, GoBD, and German HGB/AO retention rules, with a public Vanta-hosted trust center. Surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cocoon
providers.description: Cocoon is next-generation employee leave management software that automates the complexities of compliance, claims, and payroll for every type of employee leave (parental, medical, caregiver, accommodation, bereavement, and personal) across all 50 U.S. states. It factors in state, federal, company, and insurance benefits to calculate eligibility, generate designation notices, and streamline the leave experience for both employees and HR teams. Cocoon connects to 20+ HRIS and payroll platforms (Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, ADP, Paylocity, UKG, and more) via API integrations that sync employee data in real time. Founded in 2020 by former Stripe and Square leaders and backed by Index Ventures and First Round Capital, Cocoon was acquired by TriNet in April 2026. Cocoon is a consumer of HRIS/payroll APIs rather than a publisher of a public developer API; no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal are published.

providers.name: Frame Security
providers.description: Frame Security is an AI-powered human risk management and security awareness platform that defends organizations against human-targeted attacks such as phishing, deepfakes, and social engineering. Frame generates personalized security awareness training in 70+ languages, hyper-realistic email, voice, and video phishing and deepfake simulations built from an organization's own context, employee risk scoring with targeted interventions, automated phishing triage of reported suspicious emails, and cross-platform reporting and integrations. The company is backed by Index Ventures and raised a $50M round in 2026.

providers.name: PACER Case Locator (PCL)
providers.description: The PACER Case Locator (PCL) is a nationwide index of federal court cases. The public PCL API allows users to programmatically search the PCL for federal cases across U.S. district, bankruptcy, and appellate courts using the same search functionality and dataset as the PCL web application.

providers.name: RapidFort
providers.description: RapidFort is a software supply chain security platform focused on container hardening and automated CVE remediation. Its platform analyzes container vulnerabilities across build and runtime, profiles what software actually executes, and removes unused components to shrink the attack surface - remediating up to 95% of CVEs without code changes. RapidFort publishes a registry of 9,000+ near-zero-CVE curated container images and malware-scanned open-source libraries, and its CART capability automates compliance validation and remediation reporting for programs such as FedRAMP, cATO, CMMC, NIS2, and SOC 2. The company operates its platform through a hosted web application and a command-line workflow (analyze, profile, harden), with an open-source community-images catalog and the Kimia Kubernetes-native OCI image builder published on GitHub.

providers.name: The Travelers Companies
providers.description: The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV) is a leading United States property and casualty (P&C) insurance carrier providing auto, home, and business insurance to individuals, agencies, businesses, government units, and associations. Travelers is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, generated approximately $48.83 billion in revenue in 2025, holds roughly $143.7 billion in total assets, and employs approximately 34,000 people plus 15,000 independent agents and brokers across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Republic of Ireland. The company operates through three reportable segments — Business Insurance, Bond & Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance — distributing primarily through a network of independent agents and brokers, and through direct-to-consumer channels for segments of its personal lines. Travelers has a developer portal at developer.travelers.com that surfaces APIs intended for appointed agents, agency-management-system (AMS) vendors, and integration partners; the portal is gated (Salesforce Experience Cloud) and individual API specifications, endpoints, and pricing are not publicly published. The company also publishes the IntelliDrive and IntelliDrivePlus telematics mobile apps used to score personal-auto driving behavior for rating credits.

providers.name: Themis
providers.description: Themis (askthemis.com) is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) SaaS platform positioned as a "compliance collaboration" tool that streamlines partnerships between companies and their vendors, banks, credit unions, and fintechs by accelerating onboarding, due diligence, and risk assessments. The platform bundles modules for policies, procedures, documents, vendor and risk management, risk register, control mapping, issue and change management, complaints, QA testing, training, audit, key risk indicators (KRI), FINRA 4530, and conflicts of interest. Themis serves banking, payments, lending, crypto/DeFi, exchanges, BaaS, and credit-card sectors, and is used through a hosted web application at portal.askthemis.com. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public or developer API surface. Themis is a portfolio company of Felicis.

providers.name: Bloomfilter
providers.description: Bloomfilter is a process intelligence platform that gives enterprises end-to-end visibility, traceability, and control over how AI agents and humans execute software delivery work. It unifies data across development and design tools such as Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Figma into a structured, AI-enabled data stream and builds a connected process graph across the software development lifecycle. Teams use Bloomfilter to govern hybrid human-agent workflows through process mining, compliance monitoring, cycle-time analysis, and performance measurement, so leaders can see how work actually flows and where value is created or lost. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Asset Reality
providers.description: Asset Reality builds end-to-end software infrastructure for the seizure, management, custody, and disposal of both physical and virtual (crypto) assets, purpose-built for law enforcement, defense, and government agencies. Its platform unifies the asset-recovery lifecycle across four solutions — SEIZE, MANAGE, DEPLOY, and ESCROW — replacing clipboard-and-spreadsheet legacy processes with a single system that preserves asset value through investigation, confiscation, forfeiture, and reallocation to public purposes. The company is FCA-authorized to offer crypto custody in the UK, integrates with providers such as Fireblocks and Taxbit, and runs an Academy offering virtual-asset seizure certifications.

providers.name: TypeLaw
providers.description: TypeLaw is an AI-powered legal document automation platform that formats and prepares court-compliant briefs for attorneys, paralegals, and law firms. Lawyers upload a draft brief and pick the court, and TypeLaw automatically produces a compliant PDF with tables of contents, tables of authorities, hyperlinked citations, cover pages, and certificates, with a human expert reviewing every document before delivery. A Bloomberg Beta portfolio company, TypeLaw delivers its product through its web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: UpCodes
providers.description: UpCodes is a comprehensive compliance and product research platform for the construction industry, offering a searchable database of US construction and building codes consolidated by state and city for easier navigation. The platform includes libraries of codes, diagrams, and assemblies, project collaboration and bookmarking, code calculators with a BIM design data import tool, SAML single sign-on for enterprise teams, and an AI Copilot that answers code compliance questions, locates assemblies, and generates project-specific checklists. Plans span Essentials, Professional, and Enterprise tiers. UpCodes does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: claimsforce
providers.description: claimsforce GmbH is a Hamburg-based insurtech building AI-powered software for property and casualty claims management and underwriting. Its platform helps insurers, loss-adjusting and expert organizations, and independent adjusters digitize the end-to-end claims process - automating report and calculation generation, enabling video-based remote case assessment, optimizing adjuster disposition and route planning to cut travel time, and surfacing real-time analytics for claims handling and risk management. Named customers include Zurich Gruppe Deutschland, HanseMerkur, Concordia, Crawford, Sedgwick and Die Regulierer. The product is a private, login-only SaaS with no public API or developer portal as of July 2026. The company is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (TUV Rheinland) and backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Complyance
providers.description: Complyance is an AI-powered Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform for enterprise security, risk, and compliance teams. It automates manual GRC workflows across controls management, policy management, risk management, third-party and vendor risk management (TPRM), and customer trust, using purpose-built AI agents for evidence review, control advice, policy drafting, and vendor questionnaire and risk scoring. Complyance ships 100+ ready-made frameworks (including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST CSF 2.0, CMMC, and GDPR) plus 100+ enterprise integrations to centralize evidence and support audits at scale.

providers.name: ComplyBridge, Inc.
providers.description: ComplyBridge is a compliance operating system for regulated financial services firms operating in the European Economic Area — banks and credit institutions, electronic money institutions, crypto-asset service providers, payment institutions, and investment firms. The SaaS platform automates the operational compliance workload that would otherwise sit with an outside law firm or an in-house compliance team: wizard-driven license and authorisation packs (License Builder), regulatory policy generation (Policy Studio), a natural-language regulatory Copilot, obligation tracking and audit logs (Compliance Dashboard), repository scanning against the rulebook (Code Compliance), KYB intake and a director/officer/UBO Data Room, and an EU Whistleblower Directive channel (Confide). Coverage spans MiCA, PSD2/PSD3, EMD2/EMD3, MiFID II, DORA, GDPR, and the AML/CFT framework (AMLD5/6, AMLR/AMLA). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: MedHOK (Hearst Communications)
providers.description: MHK (formerly MedHOK), part of Hearst Health, is a healthcare technology company providing a unified SaaS platform for health plans and payers. Its CareProminence suite spans utilization management, care management, complaints/appeals and grievances, pharmacy management, population health and quality management, and interoperability (the MHK Interop Suite), while its MarketProminence suite covers enrollment and member maintenance, premium billing, financial reconciliation, and member web portals. MHK helps Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plans streamline operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the member experience. The MHK Interop Suite supports FHIR, SMART on FHIR, Da Vinci, and CMS-0057 interoperability requirements. MHK publishes HITRUST and ISO 27001 certification and NCQA prevalidation. The company operates a public marketing and resource site but does not publish a public developer portal or API program.

providers.name: Workhint
providers.description: Workhint is a work orchestration platform that uses AI to configure workflows, roles, and operations from modular components, helping teams manage flexible and on-demand workforces. The platform spans sourcing and onboarding, a workflow engine, tasks and projects, shifts and field visits, delivery management, auto-invoicing, global payments and payout workflows, contract management, and 1099 compliance. Backed by 500 Global and Softeq. API access and custom integrations are offered on the Enterprise plan, but no public developer portal or API documentation is published.

providers.name: Xtype
providers.description: xtype is an automated governance platform for ServiceNow, giving enterprises visibility, control, orchestration, and compliance across every instance in their ServiceNow estate — tracking changes, access decisions, and configurations and enforcing policy in real time. Products include xtype Enterprise and the free xtype View. The company is backed by ServiceNow Ventures, Columbia Capital, Norwest Venture Partners, Inner Loop Capital, and SaaS Venture Capital, with offices in Covina (CA), Tel Aviv, and Vienna. xtype publishes no public developer API: api.xtype.io is a live Kong gateway with no publicly documented routes.

providers.name: Brickanta
providers.description: Brickanta is a Stockholm-based agentic AI platform built for the construction industry, deploying specialized AI agents to automate pre-construction and project workflows including bid analysis, cost estimation, procurement package generation, document and contract review, compliance, and quality assurance. The platform reads drawings, specs, and contracts to surface risks and gaps, turns raw RFPs into discipline-specific procurement packages, and builds a searchable knowledge base from every finished project. Brickanta raised an $8M seed round led by Northzone in early 2026 and serves construction teams across eleven countries. The company exposes a customer application and a public trust portal but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Scytale
providers.description: Scytale is an AI-powered Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform that automates security compliance for cloud and SaaS companies. It combines AI agents with in-house compliance experts to automate evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, cross-framework control mapping, and audit-readiness across 80+ frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, SOX ITGC, C5, and CMMC. The platform connects to cloud providers, LLMs, HRIS, and security tooling, and offers a customizable customer-facing Trust Center plus integrated penetration testing. Scytale is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Ben
providers.description: Ben (thanksben.com) is an AI-native global employee benefits and rewards platform for enterprises.
