It unifies benefits eligibility rules, policy configuration, employee enrollment and access, spend and compliance dashboards, and rewards/recognition into a single system spanning 140+ countries, replacing fragmented regional benefits tooling. Customers include Moet, Henkel, Virgin, Zalando, Deliveroo, and Octopus Energy. Ben is backed by Seedcamp and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API today, so this profile captures the company's identity and its public security and trust surface (RFC 9116 security.txt, a Vanta-hosted Trust Center, and probed domain security).

providers.name: G2 Track
providers.description: G2 Track (formerly Cleanshelf) was a SaaS management platform providing SaaS spend monitoring, contract tracking, and usage insights. The product has since been acquired and is now offered as BetterCloud Spend Optimization.

providers.name: Qualifyze
providers.description: Qualifyze is a supplier risk management and audit platform for the life sciences and pharmaceutical industries. It helps quality, procurement, and compliance teams qualify suppliers faster, run and manage GxP audits globally, and monitor supplier risk continuously. Its Audit Management Platform streamlines audit execution, CAPA management, and real-time visibility with access to a shared library of 5,000+ audit reports, while its Quality Insights Platform layers AI-driven predictive risk monitoring on top of the supply chain. Qualifyze is a delivered SaaS product for enterprise life-sciences customers; it exposes no public developer API, portal, or documentation at this time. The company publishes ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 compliance posture.

providers.name: Fifth Dimension Ai
providers.description: Fifth Dimension (Fifth Dimension AI) is a London-based decision intelligence platform for real assets, serving commercial real estate investors, lenders, and asset managers. Its agentic AI product, Ellie, connects to a firm's existing systems — property management platforms, market data providers, deal-tracking pipelines, data rooms, OneDrive, and SharePoint — to unify fragmented institutional and market data into a single intelligence layer. Ellie automates document-heavy workflows: extracting and structuring data, screening deals, preparing analyses, drafting investment-committee memos, monitoring portfolio variance, and proactively surfacing risk, while keeping every insight transparent and auditable rather than a black box. Founded in 2023, the company is backed by Speedinvest, Anthemis, Seedcamp, and HV Capital and has raised more than $40M across seed and Series A rounds. The platform is built on an API-first architecture and is SOC 2 Type II compliant, ISO 27001 certified, and GDPR compliant, with isolated customer environments and a no-training data policy.

providers.name: VendorPM
providers.description: VendorPM is a PropTech procurement and vendor-lifecycle-management platform for the commercial real estate industry, unifying vendor credentialing, compliance screening, eTendering/eBidding, procurement, and contract management under a single login. Its marketplace connects property managers with a network of 50,000+ vendors to fulfill building services and contracts of all sizes, while an AI Procurement CoPilot surfaces recommendations and a Yardi Voyager ERP integration syncs vendor compliance and profile data. VendorPM serves 100+ property management groups and 6,000+ buildings across the US and Canada. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company; VendorPM exposes no public self-serve developer API — its Yardi/ERP integration is provisioned through a Customer Success Manager.

providers.name: Agworld
providers.description: Agworld is a collaborative farm-management platform - now part of the Semios Group and majority-owned by Telus Agriculture & Consumer Goods - used by growers, agronomists, and ag retailers to plan, schedule, record, and report on field activities. The product surface covers planning, scheduling, precision spray records, agronomic and financial insights, and compliance reporting. Agworld integrates with John Deere, Climate-style monitor data via Agworld DBX, plus Figured, PowerBI, Shed, CalAg, Frames, CART by FarmReady, and Mobble. The companion DBX product is a label, manufacturer, ingredient, and pest database (Greenbook). Agworld does not publish an open public developer portal; partner integrations are arranged through their team.

providers.name: DeepIP
providers.description: DeepIP is an AI-powered patent intelligence platform that streamlines the full patent lifecycle for intellectual-property professionals, automating repetitive work while keeping a human in the loop. It supports invention capture, patentability assessment, patent drafting and drawings generation, AI review, prosecution support, freedom-to-operate (FTO) and invalidity searches, portfolio and landscape intelligence, and agentic prior-art search. DeepIP embeds directly into Microsoft Word, IP management systems, and the web browser, and works across chemistry, biology, software, mechanical, and electronic domains and multiple patent jurisdictions (USPTO, EPO, PCT, UKIPO, CNIPA, KIPO, and others). The company operates a zero-data-retention policy on U.S.-based Microsoft Azure and holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and GDPR compliance. DeepIP is backed by Balderton Capital.

providers.name: UptimeHealth
providers.description: UptimeHealth is a healthcare operations platform for managing medical equipment service, compliance documentation, and facility maintenance across dental, medical, and veterinary practices from a single dashboard. The platform tracks devices, automates compliance tasks and logs, and coordinates repair service requests, reporting 73,000+ devices protected across 6,000+ facilities. UptimeHealth publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation — its platform (uptimecontroller.com) is a closed SaaS application.

providers.name: Md Ally
providers.description: MD Ally is a New York-based digital health company that integrates telehealth into the 911 emergency response system. Its platform lets emergency dispatchers route low-acuity, non-emergency callers to a virtual care tier, connecting patients with telehealth clinicians, in-network resources, and social services instead of dispatching EMS or defaulting to an emergency-room visit. MD Ally works with public safety agencies and payers to expand traditional two-tier dispatch models, reduce unnecessary ambulance transports and ER visits, and improve patient navigation. Backed by General Catalyst and Techstars.

providers.name: Moritz
providers.description: Moritz is an AI-native law firm delivering commercial, corporate, and employment legal work with same-day turnaround at transparent flat-rate pricing. Founded in 2025 by Pamir Ehsas (former outside counsel to OpenAI and Google) and Stefan Mandaric (ex-Fulbright scholar at MIT), the firm uses AI to complete roughly 80% of the work (intake and first draft) with 50+ contracted co-counsel lawyers finalizing every matter. Moritz operates across the EU, US, and Australia and reports having supported more than 100 companies in closing agreements representing over $2B in aggregate contract value. It is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company that raised a $9M seed round backed by 20VC, the Urban Innovation Fund, and 20 unicorn founders. Moritz is a legal-services company; it does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Own (OwnBackup)
providers.description: Own (formerly OwnBackup, now Own from Salesforce) is a SaaS data protection platform that provides backup, recovery, archiving, sandbox seeding, and data security and compliance for cloud applications including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and ServiceNow. Founded in 2015 and acquired by Salesforce in 2024, Own helps organizations protect and manage the data held in their business-critical SaaS systems against loss, corruption, and compliance risk. Own is delivered as a managed product rather than a public developer API platform: it operates a public system status page and a trust center listing its security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701, FedRAMP, HDS, GDPR, HIPAA/HITECH) and a published vulnerability disclosure policy, but does not currently publish an open, self-serve REST/OpenAPI developer surface.

providers.name: Skuad
providers.description: Skuad is a global HR and employment platform (now part of Payoneer as Payoneer Workforce Management) that lets companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage full-time employees and contractors across 160+ countries without setting up local legal entities. It provides employer-of-record (EOR) services, international payroll in 70+ currencies, contractor management and payments, benefits administration, background verification, and built-in compliance with local employment, tax, and labor laws. Skuad was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched from Skuad's public web presence. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Sprinto
providers.description: Sprinto is a security and compliance automation platform supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, and more. Sprinto offers an API for building custom compliance and risk workflows; specific public reference docs are limited and require a customer login.

providers.name: Sweep
providers.description: Sweep is an enterprise carbon and ESG data management platform helping large organizations measure, manage, report, and reduce their carbon emissions and broader sustainability performance across Scope 1, 2, and 3 following the GHG Protocol. Its platform centralizes sustainability data across an organization and its value chain to produce audit-ready data from a single source, covering carbon accounting, ESG disclosure, value-chain engagement with supplier portals and automated data collection, audit and assurance trails, and business intelligence with dashboards and scenario modeling. Sweep supports compliance with the CSRD, ISSB, GRI, CDP, SFDR, TCFD, UK SRS, the GHG Protocol, and US state regulation including California SB 253 and SB 261, with vertical solutions for asset managers, asset owners, private markets, banks, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, energy, and consumer goods. Sweep was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape 2026 for Carbon Management and recognized in the Verdantix 2026 Green Quadrant. The platform exposes data ingestion via API and SFTP and integrates with ERP, procurement, and HRMS systems, but Sweep does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repos — API access is delivered through customer engagements rather than a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Andesite
providers.description: Andesite is a cybersecurity company building a Human+AI Security Operations Center (SOC) platform that connects human analysts, AI agents, and security data to automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation, and response. Its Decision Fabric connects data silos and organizational context, while Evidentiary AI provides audit trails for every AI-driven action. Andesite deploys as SaaS or self-managed, carries FedRAMP High Authorization and SOC 2 Type II compliance, and is a General Catalyst portfolio company operating in the defense and government sector.

providers.name: Enzai
providers.description: Enzai is an enterprise AI governance platform that helps organizations adopt AI while managing regulatory and operational risk. Its product suite spans agentic AI governance (real-time analysis, risk flagging, and agent-sprawl management), AI use-case intake and approval workflows, a centralized AI registry inventorying first- and third-party AI systems, and compliance frameworks that map AI initiatives to the EU AI Act, GDPR, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001. Enzai is headquartered in Belfast with a London office, is ISO 27001 certified, and is backed by venture capital including Seedcamp. No public API or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Leah
providers.description: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi and legally ContractPod Technologies Limited, is a London-headquartered enterprise agentic AI company that unifies contract lifecycle management, legal transformation, procurement, and finance operations into a single autonomous system. Its Leah Agentic OS platform provides skills-based orchestration, agentic workflows, a natural-language app builder, a library of domain-specific legal, contracting, procurement, and finance agents, and the Leah Maestro enterprise orchestrator. Leah is a five-time Gartner CLM Visionary, is SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, and is used by enterprises including PwC, KPMG, Philips, Alaska Airlines, MUFG, and Cushman & Wakefield. Leah ships pre-built connectors and describes open REST APIs for enterprise integration, but maintains no public developer portal or published API reference — API access is unlocked through the enterprise contract.

providers.name: Lizzyai
providers.description: Lizzy is a generative-AI platform for legal professionals, delivering a secure Gen AI workspace across all practice areas through both a web application and a Microsoft Word/Outlook add-in. It supports contract drafting, review, analysis, and proofreading, customizable legal workflows and playbooks, in-document citations, redlining and track-changes, and the handling of long, scanned, watermarked, and multiple documents. A multi-LLM approach routes each task to the most capable model, and firms can train a private model that embeds their own know-how. Built for enterprise IT with a zero-trust architecture, no training on customer data, PII anonymization, SSO via SAML and OAuth 2.0, and shared, VPC, or self-hosted deployment options.

providers.name: Softheon
providers.description: Softheon is a healthcare technology company that provides SaaS software for health plans, brokers, and government agencies to run shopping and enrollment, billing and payments, member renewals, reporting and analytics, and compliance across the ACA marketplace, ICHRA, dental, and Medicare Advantage markets. Its all-in-one platform automates health-insurance administration end to end and is increasingly layering in agentic AI to streamline operations at scale. Founded around 2000 and headquartered in Stony Brook, New York, Softheon operates a developer portal (developer.softheon.com) and a compliance trust center, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Valerie Health
providers.description: Valerie Health is an AI-powered front office platform for independent healthcare provider groups, automating referral management, fax and document classification and data extraction, appointment scheduling, and growth analytics on top of existing EMR and practice management systems. Founded by Pete Shalek and Nitin Joshi and backed by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures with a $30M Series A, the company operates as a HIPAA Business Associate for its provider customers and publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center, but does not currently publish a developer portal or public API documentation.

providers.name: Makersite
providers.description: Makersite is an AI-powered Product Lifecycle Intelligence platform that helps manufacturers manage product sustainability, cost, and compliance by connecting products to deep-tier supply chain, material, and chemical data. The platform automates lifecycle assessments (LCA) and product carbon footprint (PCF) calculations, supports eco-design and cost optimization, and produces regulatory reporting such as EU Taxonomy and CBAM. It integrates with enterprise CAD, ERP, and PLM systems (PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter, Autodesk, ANSYS). Makersite is a portfolio company of Partech. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Behavox
providers.description: Behavox is an AI-native compliance and conduct-surveillance software company serving the world's leading financial institutions and regulated enterprises. Its Unified AI Controls Platform spans directive, preventive, detective, and corrective controls — including Quantum (voice and text communication surveillance across 50+ languages and 150+ channels), Polaris (trade surveillance), Falcon (insider-threat and human-risk detection), Compass (conflicts of interest and personal account dealing), Atlas (control-room enforcement), Pathfinder (regulatory-change-to-policy), Intelligent Archive, Digital Employees, and Mosaic front-office revenue intelligence. Behavox is backed by Index Ventures and the SoftBank Vision Fund. The company sells directly to enterprise financial-services customers and does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Newfront
providers.description: Newfront is a modern business insurance brokerage and technology company headquartered in San Francisco. It combines a traditional insurance brokerage (commercial business insurance, employee benefits, retirement services, and risk management) with a software platform that gives clients transparent data and analytics to understand and lower their total cost of risk. Formed from the merger of Newfront and ABD Insurance, the company serves technology, venture-backed, and enterprise clients across property and casualty, health and benefits, and personal lines. Backed by Index Ventures, Susa Ventures, and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass Newfront exposes a client-facing web application (app.newfront.com) but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Zip Security
providers.description: Zip Security is a cloud-based security, IT, and compliance platform that automates identity management, device management (MDM for macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android), and endpoint threat detection for small and mid-sized businesses. It unifies tools such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, and CrowdStrike behind a single dashboard, deploying frameworks, policies, and controls that are continuously enforced to help teams reach SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CMMC, and PCI readiness, often within two weeks. Zip Security is backed by General Catalyst. This profile currently exposes no public developer API; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: DeepStream Technologies
providers.description: DeepStream Technologies (deep.stream) is a London-based AI-enhanced eSourcing and source-to-contract platform for mid-market procurement teams. It digitalizes buyer-to-supplier sourcing with best-of-breed eRFx, supplier discovery, supplier pre-qualification, eAuctions, contract management, management reporting, and AI-driven RFP generation and conversational analytics, aiming to help procurement teams work faster, reduce risk, and gain visibility while keeping implementation simple. Customers include Walkers Shortbread, BrewDog, Abbott, and Free Now. DeepStream does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation; integrations with ERP and PO systems are delivered as a service. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with public company and infrastructure signals.

providers.name: FireMon
providers.description: FireMon is a cybersecurity company providing firewall and security policy management across hybrid, on-premises, and cloud environments. Its platform normalizes and governs security policies spanning firewalls, cloud security groups, and microsegmentation tools, delivering compliance automation, policy optimization, change automation, and real-time risk insight. FireMon serves more than 1,700 customers across 70+ countries, concentrated in healthcare, financial services, retail, and manufacturing. Its Security Manager platform exposes a REST API, delivered per-install (self-hosted or cloud appliance) rather than as a single public hosted endpoint. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from FireMon's public web and documentation surface.

providers.name: LeaseLock
providers.description: LeaseLock is an insurtech platform for rental housing that replaces the traditional cash security deposit with lease insurance. Its Zero Deposit program embeds coverage into the lease through a signed addendum, removing thousands of dollars of move-in cost for residents while protecting owners and operators against unpaid rent and damage. LeaseLock Shield applies AI to ledger data, market trends and lease profiles to underwrite risk, and LeaseLock Central gives property teams a portal for claims, support tickets and training. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Dallas, Texas, the company says it integrates with all major property management systems, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference or client SDKs — integration is arranged as a managed engagement. Its public engineering output is two open-source PostgreSQL extensions, pgasync and pgflow.

providers.name: Pointone
providers.description: PointOne is an AI-powered legal practice management platform that automates time entry, billing compliance, and analytics for law firms. Its products include PointOne Time (automatic cross-device time capture with AI-generated narratives), PointOne Review (pre-bill review with AI markup and collaboration), and PointOne Intelligence (time analytics and resource-allocation insights), along with automatic enforcement of Outside Counsel Guidelines. The platform syncs with billing systems including Aderant, Clio, Filevine, QuickBooks, Actionstep, Elite 3E, Surepoint, MyCase, and LeanLaw, and serves 200+ law firms. PointOne is backed by Bessemer, Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and 8VC. No public developer API is currently published; integrations are delivered as pre-built connectors.

providers.name: Salient
providers.description: Salient (Skwid Inc.) is an AI-native loan servicing and collections platform for consumer lenders — banks, credit unions, captive lenders, and specialty finance companies. It builds compliance-first AI voice and chat agents that automate servicing, collections, audit, insurance claims, chargebacks, and chargeoff workflows with native FDCPA, TCPA, and CFPB compliance. Its named agent products include Taylor (omnichannel servicing and collections), Marshall (automated audit), Flyn (total-loss insurance claims), Alex (chargebacks and disputes), and Melanie (chargeoffs). Founded in 2023 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Matrix Partners, and Y Combinator, Salient exposes a partner integration and onboarding API behind an authenticated developer portal. This profile was enriched from public web surfaces; the API reference is gated behind login so no public machine-readable specification was harvested.

providers.name: Vallor
providers.description: Vallor (Board AI, Inc.) is an AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams that puts contracts on autopilot. Val reads every contract across the existing stack, drafts redlines against a playbook, flags risks, monitors obligations, renewals, SLAs, and rebates against live ERP and AP data, and answers plain-English questions with citations back to the source clause. It connects to 1,000+ systems including SAP, NetSuite, Snowflake, Salesforce, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign, and Slack, and ships a first-party Claude Code / Cowork plugin marketplace with 32 agent skills and 9 background agents for contract management and strategic sourcing. SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR compliant, with customer data staying in the customer tenant. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Dropsuite
providers.description: Dropsuite, now a NinjaOne company, is a cloud backup, archiving, and recovery platform built for managed service providers (MSPs) and their small-to-midsize business customers. It provides automated backup and one-click restore for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, email, and website/database data, plus long-term email archiving with legal hold, eDiscovery, and journaling for compliance. Partners manage tenants through a multi-tenant portal and can automate provisioning, reporting, and reconciliation through a partner REST API gated to Direct Partners and Distributors (credentials issued in the Partner Portal under Settings -> API Settings). Dropsuite was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Headnote
providers.description: Headnote is a legal payments and accounts-receivable platform built specifically for law firms. Founded in 2016 by attorney Sarah Schaaf, it lets firms accept trust-compliant credit card and eCheck (ACH) payments via shareable payment links and a hosted client payment portal, then automates collections, AR tracking, and client NPS/satisfaction reporting. Headnote is designed to be 100% compliant with IOLTA rules, the ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct, and lawyer trust/operating account requirements across all 50 states, and integrates with existing billing and practice-management software by attaching a Headnote payment link to invoices. Card and bank data are tokenized with Stripe and Plaid and the platform runs on AWS with PCI-compliant, encrypted-at-rest-and-in-transit infrastructure. Headnote was acquired by ASG LegalTech (an Alpine Investors platform, alongside PracticePanther, Bill4Time, and MerusCase) in 2020. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. Headnote does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile is an identity record.

providers.name: HireArt
providers.description: HireArt is a workforce management platform that helps enterprises source, employ, and manage their contingent workforce - contract workers, freelancers, and staffing vendors - through a single self-serve system. Its products span Employer of Record (EOR), on-demand sourcing and recruitment, a Vendor Management System (VMS), worker classification and compliance (1099 vs. W-2 with indemnification), program management, and freelancer management. Customers include Toyota Research Institute, Zoox, Via, Scale AI, Dropbox, Meta Quest, Carta, and Rover. HireArt was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Lateral
providers.description: Lateral was a Berlin- and Hobart-based AI research software company founded in 2013 that built machine-learning powered content recommendation and document navigation tools. Its early product was a conceptual text-matching and recommendation API that let developers insert documents and retrieve semantically similar content, with pre-populated corpora covering arXiv, PubMed, Wikipedia, news and SEC filings. The company later pivoted to an LLM-assisted research workspace for navigating information across large document sets, and published open-source research on hyperbolic-space word embeddings (Poincare embeddings, hyperplane hashers, WARP recommenders). Lateral was permanently shut down on 26 June 2025; the team pointed users to a successor open-source research platform at coordination.network. The public API, its documentation host and the application host are all retired, so this profile documents a historical API surface and the client libraries that remain published.

providers.name: Lockton
providers.description: Lockton Companies is the world's largest privately held, independent insurance brokerage, founded by Jack Lockton in 1966 and headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, United States. Lockton is a broker and intermediary rather than a risk carrier: it places commercial property and casualty, specialty and financial lines, employee benefits and people solutions, private client coverage, and — through Lockton Re — treaty and facultative reinsurance, for tens of thousands of clients across a global network of associates and offices reaching more than 140 locations. Its API posture is honestly characterized as partner-gated with no public API surface. As of July 2026 Lockton publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or Swagger definition, no GraphQL endpoint, no Postman workspace, and no webhook or event catalog. The hostnames developer.lockton.com, developers.lockton.com, docs.lockton.com and api.lockton.com do not resolve in DNS, and a crawl of the 6,953 URLs in global.lockton.com/sitemap.xml surfaces no developer, API, ACORD, IVANS, OpenAPI or Swagger path. Client-facing technology is delivered through authenticated regional Lockton Client Portals and the proprietary Lockton SAGE intelligence and analytics ecosystem, which is presented on the website behind a contact form with no self-serve access, no documented data feed and no published integration surface. This is the expected posture for a US broker-intermediary: the United States has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate, so data exchange between carriers, brokers and agency management systems runs on ACORD standards in an EDI and forms idiom rather than a public API idiom. Lockton's most substantive standards signal is governance rather than implementation — in July 2026 Nidhi Howell, Chief Business Technology Officer of Lockton Re, was appointed to the ACORD Solutions Group Board of Directors representing the reinsurance broking channel — but no ACORD AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS or IVANS agency-download implementation is documented on any public Lockton property.

providers.name: Page
providers.description: Page is an AI-powered government relations (GR) platform that tracks legislation, regulatory activity, and policy developments across 70+ jurisdictions in real time. It provides bill tracking, regulatory affairs monitoring, live hearing and vote alerts, lobbying and parliamentary questions data, smart alerts, AI analysis of policy trends, and detailed politician and staff directories, alongside Wonk — an AI assistant for policy research and document generation. Page serves enterprises, multi-client firms, law firms, government agencies, associations, and nonprofits. It is headquartered in Washington, DC with an additional office in Waterloo, Ontario, and is backed by Canaan Partners. Page holds SOC 2 Type II certification. As of this profile Page exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Ferrum Health
providers.description: Ferrum Health is a healthcare AI governance company whose AI Governance Suite lets health systems deploy, validate, orchestrate, and monitor clinical AI models securely behind their own firewall, without protected health information leaving the health system. The vendor-neutral, privately deployed platform integrates once with existing EMR, PACS, and worklist infrastructure, then routes every clinical AI model — FDA-cleared, CE-marked, open-source, or homegrown — through a single secure path via its Deployment Fabric, curates 60+ applications in its Model Hub across radiology, cardiology, oncology, neurology, and musculoskeletal specialties, and continuously links predictions, ground truth, and outcomes for bias and drift detection through its Observability Lens. It is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR aligned, and is used by Sutter Health, Carle Health, and 250+ sites.

providers.name: Paxton AI
providers.description: Paxton AI is a legal AI assistant built for attorneys and law firms, delivering rapid case-law and regulatory research, AI-assisted document drafting, file analysis, deposition and discovery summarization, and specialized workflows for medical chronologies and billing summaries. Founded by Tanguy Chau (CEO) and Michael Ulin and headquartered in Bend, Oregon, the company has raised roughly $28M across a $6M seed round led by WVV Capital and a $22M Series A led by Unusual Ventures, with participation from Kyber Knight and 25Madison. Paxton's platform covers US federal regulations, state laws, and case law across all fifty states, surfaces precise authority-linked citations, and runs in a closed model environment that is SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA compliant with data never used for model training. The product is delivered as a web SaaS targeted at solo practitioners, small and mid-size firms, and enterprise legal teams across personal injury, family, employment, criminal, and corporate practice areas; commercial access is sold via per-seat Individual plans ($499/month or $2,999/year) and a volume-priced Enterprise plan, with a 7-day free trial. Paxton publishes a small public GitHub presence with citator and legal-hallucination benchmark datasets but does not offer a public developer API, SDK, or open-source platform.

providers.name: Boundless
providers.description: Boundless is a Seattle-based technology-enabled immigration company that pairs an intuitive online platform with licensed immigration attorneys to help individuals and businesses navigate U.S. immigration. Its consumer products cover family-based green cards, marriage and fiancé (K-1) visas, naturalization and citizenship, and employment-based visas such as H-1B, EB-1, O-1, and E-2, while its business offering adds corporate case management, workflow automation, employee engagement, compliance management, HR-system integration, and global mobility support for immigration teams. Boundless is backed by Foundry Group and Seedcamp. No public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: DoNotPay
providers.description: DoNotPay is an AI-powered consumer advocacy platform, founded in 2015 by Joshua Browder and marketed as the "robot lawyer." It offers a web-based consumer product with 100+ AI-assisted tools that help people cancel subscriptions and free trials, dispute parking tickets and traffic violations, file chargebacks and refunds, negotiate and lower bills, find unclaimed money, fight robocalls, generate virtual cards for safe trial signups, and automate customer-service interactions. DoNotPay is a direct consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it is tracked here as an API Evangelist company profile.

providers.name: Native Security
providers.description: Native Security is a cloud security control plane that unifies security posture and enforcement across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and OCI. The platform translates security intent expressed in natural language into enforceable architectural controls, shifting teams from reactive detection toward proactive, secure-by-design defense using built-in cloud security primitives. Capabilities include multi-cloud policy enforcement from a single definition, automated organization topology discovery and mapping, architectural segmentation and perimeter enforcement, AI-agent guardrails through architectural boundaries, and compliance automation with audit readiness. Native Security is backed by General Catalyst. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; product documentation and the application console sit behind authentication.

providers.name: Tacto
providers.description: Tacto (Tacto Technology GmbH) is a Munich-based AI procurement intelligence platform for manufacturing companies. It unifies internal ERP and engineering data with external market intelligence to power AI agents that automate procurement work across four areas: Supplier Intelligence (centralized supplier management with documents, evaluations and performance data), Spend & Cost Intelligence (spend analysis and savings identification), Sourcing Intelligence (AI-optimized RFQ and price inquiries) and Compliance Intelligence (automated regulatory and supply-chain due-diligence detection). Tacto is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant with EU-only hosting and an audit log of every AI action. It does not publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures the company's corporate, security and compliance surface.

providers.name: Banking Regulation
providers.description: Banking regulation encompasses the rules, standards, and frameworks governing banks and financial institutions. Key frameworks include the Basel Accords (Basel I, II, III, IV) for capital adequacy, the Dodd-Frank Act in the US, PSD2 and CRD IV/V in Europe, and anti-money laundering (AML) / know-your-customer (KYC) requirements. Regulatory technology (RegTech) APIs and data services help financial institutions automate compliance reporting, risk management, and supervisory data submissions.

providers.name: Eleos Health
providers.description: Eleos Health is the most widely adopted AI platform in behavioral and community-based healthcare. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, Eleos delivers purpose-built AI workflow agents that span clinical documentation, compliance, and revenue cycle management. The platform embeds directly inside providers' existing web-based electronic health records (EHRs) via a lightweight browser extension for both in-person and telehealth sessions, turning ambient session capture or quick text summaries into structured, payer-ready progress notes and cutting documentation time by roughly 70%. Eleos Compliance reviews every note against common risk areas (note cloning, empty notes, interventions, progress mentions, action plans, and the golden thread), and its revenue cycle tooling automates eligibility checks and claim protection. Deployed across 120+ care organizations in 30+ states, Eleos integrates without custom API builds; it is backed by Menlo Ventures and Greenfield Partners.

providers.name: Nirvana Tech
providers.description: Nirvana Insurance (Nirvana Tech, Inc.) is a technology-driven commercial trucking insurance provider that pairs A-rated fleet insurance coverage with an AI-powered active safety platform. Nirvana ingests telematics and connected-vehicle data from motor carriers to price risk more accurately, help fleets save up to 20% on premiums, and reduce accidents through real-time safety alerts, driver coaching, and predictive risk scoring. The company serves fleets and independent insurance agents through a digital quoting and policy-management agent portal, and is backed by General Catalyst. Nirvana raised a Series D round to expand its data-driven insurance and safety products across the trucking industry. As of this profile Nirvana operates a marketing site plus an agent sign-in portal and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Odaseva
providers.description: Odaseva is an enterprise data security, backup, and governance platform purpose-built for large, complex Salesforce environments. It provides data backup and recovery, archiving, seeding and anonymization/masking, encryption and key management, privacy and data-residency controls, and data governance for regulated enterprises. Odaseva holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, HITRUST, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, TISAX, IRAP, MLPS 2.0, and CSA STAR Level 2, with independent audits by Ernst & Young. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network; Odaseva sells to enterprises and does not publish a public developer API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: OpenGamma
providers.description: OpenGamma is a derivatives and margin analytics company whose technology helps trading, risk, treasury and operations teams forecast, stress test, simulate and reduce the collateral and margin costs of trading cleared and bilateral derivatives. Its capabilities span Forecast, Stress Test, Simulate, Reduce, Allocate, Process, Explain, Validate and Comply. OpenGamma's public developer surface is Strata, its award-winning open-source (Apache 2.0) analytics and market-risk library for pricing and risk of OTC and exchange-traded derivatives, which also powers OpenGamma's commercial SaaS Analytics platform. Strata is a Java library published to Maven Central under com.opengamma.strata, with a bundled command-line tool, Javadoc reference and community forum; OpenGamma does not expose a public REST API. OpenGamma is backed by Accel and was acquired by Trading Technologies.

providers.name: General Legal
providers.description: General Legal is an AI-native law firm for high-growth startups and SMBs, offering flat-fee commercial, corporate, and employment legal work delivered by U.S.-barred attorneys augmented with proprietary AI workflows. The firm focuses on contract review, redlining, negotiation, and drafting with transparent flat pricing (from $250) and fast turnaround (median under three hours), positioning itself as "outside counsel that scales like software." Practice areas include technology transactions, employment, data privacy, financial regulatory, blockchain/cryptocurrency, and emerging companies / VC. Founded in 2026 by Ryan Walker (ex-Casetext CTO), J.P. Mohler, and Javed Qadruddin, the company is a Y Combinator (W26) portfolio company that raised $11.5M across pre-seed and seed rounds. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from public sources; General Legal is a legal-services company and does not currently publish a developer API.

providers.name: Tugboat Logic
providers.description: Tugboat Logic is a security assurance and compliance automation platform acquired by OneTrust in 2021. It supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and NIST. As of 2024, the product has been rebranded under OneTrust's Certification Automation offering; legacy Tugboat Logic APIs are not publicly documented and integrations now flow through OneTrust's developer platform.

providers.name: Airhelp
providers.description: AirHelp is a passenger-rights platform that helps air travelers claim compensation for delayed, cancelled, and overbooked flights under regulations such as EU 261, UK 261, and similar laws worldwide. It handles the full claims process on a "no win, no fee" basis, managing paperwork, airline negotiations, and legal escalation on the passenger's behalf, and offers an AirHelp+ membership adding fast-track claims, flight-disruption assistance, and airport lounge access. AirHelp operates a consumer web funnel and mobile apps plus a network of travel-brand, corporate, and affiliate partnerships, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization hosts internal engineering tooling rather than API client libraries. This profile was seeded as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from AirHelp's public web surface.

providers.name: Brown & Brown
providers.description: Brown & Brown, Inc. (NYSE: BRO) is a Daytona Beach, Florida headquartered insurance brokerage and risk-management intermediary founded in 1939, and one of the largest independent brokers in the United States. Following the 2025 acquisition of Accession Risk Management Group (Risk Strategies and One80 Intermediaries), it reports through two segments: Retail — property and casualty insurance, employee benefits, private client, captive solutions and financial/wealth services — and Specialty Distribution — programs, wholesale brokerage and MGA/binding-authority businesses including Arrowhead. As a distributor rather than a carrier, Brown & Brown places risk with insurers instead of underwriting it, and its US home market has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate. Its API posture reflects that honestly: Brown & Brown publishes no public developer portal and no self-serve API. developer.bbrown.com, developers.bbrown.com, docs.bbrown.com and api.bbrown.com do not resolve, and every /developers, /api, /partners and /integrations path returns 404. Every discoverable application subdomain is a login wall — agent, client and vendor portals behind Microsoft Entra ID SSO or third-party sign-in. The only real programmatic surface is partner-gated: the Arrowhead Programs "Enterprise API" (EAPI), a quoting integration distributed through comparative raters and aggregators such as CoverHound, Tarmika, Semsee and DAIS, with no public documentation, base URL or specification. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference is published on any Brown & Brown first-party property; carrier data exchange runs, as it does across US retail brokerage, through the agency management system layer — Brown & Brown is a publicly referenced Vertafore AMS360 agency — and IVANS agency download rather than through any API Brown & Brown itself exposes. In July 2026 the company announced an AI-first transformation with Anthropic, McKinsey and Accenture, deploying Claude across 23,000 teammates and Claude Code across its software engineering organization; that is internal adoption and has so far produced no external API, developer portal or agent-facing surface. The only machine-readable documents Brown & Brown publishes are two RSS feeds — the blog and investor news releases.

providers.name: FreeWill
providers.description: FreeWill is an online estate-planning platform that lets people create legal documents for free, including last wills, revocable living trusts (California only), advance healthcare directives, financial powers of attorney, and beneficiary designations, through a guided questionnaire. It runs a dual model: individuals use the tools at no cost, while more than 2,400 nonprofit organizations partner with FreeWill for planned-giving and legacy-gift features. Related surfaces include the Estately advisor platform and a Nonprofit Solutions offering. FreeWill was surfaced as a portfolio company of iconiq-capital and qed-investors. Enrichment found no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or API documentation — this profile is a consumer/nonprofit company record, not an API producer, with security and legal properties captured from the public site.

providers.name: HelloVerify
providers.description: HelloVerify is India's leading background verification (BGV) and employee screening company, delivering fast, accurate, and compliant primary-source verification for employment, education, healthcare credentialing, immigration, and enterprise workforce programs. The platform has completed 20M+ verifications for 2000+ organizations across 120+ countries, offering AI-powered background checks, customer KYC with identity and liveness, vendor due diligence (Certifier), and instant messaging-based verification (HelloV). HelloVerify operates an audited information-security and compliance program (ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, Cyber Essentials, GDPR) and serves regulators, enterprises, SMBs, and applicants worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network as a dcvc portfolio company; no public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Cleardata
providers.description: ClearDATA is healthcare's dedicated cloud security, compliance, and operations partner, helping providers, payers, health-tech software companies, medical device makers, and life sciences organizations build and run on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud in a HIPAA- and HITRUST-aligned way. Its offering spans Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) with 300+ healthcare-specific safeguards, Managed Detection & Response (MDR), automated Cloud Compliance, and Cloud Operations, delivered through the CyberHealth platform and managed/professional services. ClearDATA is an AWS Level 1 MSSP and Microsoft Gold Partner, and maps controls to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, NIST, ISO, PCI, and GDPR. ClearDATA is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; ClearDATA does not publish a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Tulyp
providers.description: Tulyp is a SaaS treasury platform from French company SmarTrade SAS that gives CFOs and treasurers of SMEs and mid-caps (10-200M euro revenue) real-time visibility into their foreign-exchange (FX) exposure. The platform aggregates financial data from connected ERPs, accounting software, and banks, calculates net currency exposure by type and timeframe, translates currency movements into impact on revenue, margins, and EBITDA, and alerts when exposure crosses risk-policy thresholds. Backed by Speedinvest. Tulyp publishes no public developer API; it does publish an llms.txt content index for AI systems.

providers.name: University Startups
providers.description: University Startups is an AI-powered transition planning management platform built for special education teams. The platform helps teachers create IDEA-compliant IEP transition plans in under 10 minutes, audits plans against 11 IDEA Indicator 13 criteria in under 90 seconds, generates SMART-format IEP goals, and engages students with disabilities in building their own transition plans, alongside a college and career readiness curriculum and internship simulator. A Techstars portfolio company serving United States school districts including NYC Public Schools; no public developer API surface is published.

providers.name: Beyond Limits
providers.description: Beyond Limits (trading as BeyondAI) is an enterprise and industrial artificial intelligence company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Glendale, California, built on cognitive and neuro-symbolic AI technology licensed from Caltech and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Its Hybrid AI Platform combines machine learning, generative AI and rule-based symbolic reasoning so that industrial operators get explainable, auditable recommendations instead of black-box predictions. Products include the Hybrid AI Platform (with Data, ML Ops/PRE, KB Ops and a low-code API available under a development license), Operations Advisor, Beyond Search generative AI, AI in a Box on-premises infrastructure, and DocLink document process automation from its Altec subsidiary. The company sells into energy and LNG, oil and gas, refining, petrochemicals, utilities, mining, manufacturing, aerospace and critical infrastructure. Beyond Limits publishes no public developer portal, API reference or self-service sign-up; platform API access is granted to licensed customers, so there is no publicly discoverable machine-readable contract for this provider.

providers.name: Dialogus
providers.description: Dialogus is a frontier AI voice lab building infrastructure for enterprise-grade voice agents that resolve, trace, and control every live conversation across phone systems, internal workflows, and customer systems. Its platform connects voice agents to phone systems, internal tools, databases, CRMs, and messaging channels, with human escalation flows, monitoring, and compliance built in. Agents run a Listen, Reason, Act, and Report loop that detects turns, silence, and intent, constrains the model with workflow state and policies, executes approved tools, and produces auditable transcripts and outcomes. Dialogus targets live customer support, phone order-taking into the POS, and past-due collections, and positions itself as SOC 2 compliant for live operations. Founded by ex-Google, Meta, and Microsoft engineers, it is a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: Hyperproof
providers.description: Hyperproof is a continuous compliance and risk management platform that automates evidence collection, control management, and audit workflows. It exposes a public REST API covering 20+ resources (Controls, Policies, Programs, Risks, Proof, Tasks, Issues, Vendors, Users, Groups, Roles, Scopes, Questionnaires, Custom Apps, Labels, and more) plus the Hypersync SDK for custom integrations.

providers.name: Aceiss
providers.description: Aceiss is a security monitoring and access-visibility platform that gives CISOs and risk managers continuous insight into who has access to their GitHub organizations and repositories. It monitors user access across repositories, detects unauthorized or anomalous activity in real time, and produces governance and compliance reporting mapped to frameworks such as NIST, CIS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CSA STAR, HITRUST, and SOC 2. Aceiss installs from the GitHub Marketplace as a read-only app requiring admin privileges and exposes an API for integrating its real-time access data into existing systems, with spreadsheet and PDF export. The company is backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Maywood
providers.description: Maywood is a Y Combinator (W26) artificial-intelligence startup building a finance-compliant, proactive AI platform that automates deal execution for investment banks. The product runs continuously across a banker's network, pipeline, and active M&A processes, generating client-ready CIMs, pitch decks, and financial models, drafting outreach in the banker's voice, and managing due-diligence workflows through a connected data layer that updates automatically. Maywood is built to FINRA and SEC requirements: autonomous within scope, human-approved at every external boundary, and fully reconstructable in between. Founded in 2026 and based in New York City, it is an early-stage SaaS company with no public developer API at this time; this profile tracks its public web, security, and trust surfaces so the network can detect an API program when one appears.

providers.name: Comply365
providers.description: Comply365 is an enterprise SaaS provider of operational content, safety, and training management software for highly regulated, safety-critical industries including airlines, defense, rail, and MRO (maintenance, repair, and overhaul). Its AI-powered platform unifies three mission-critical products: ContentManager365 for authoring, managing, and distributing controlled operational documentation and manuals; SafetyManager365 for safety reporting, investigation, and root-cause analysis; and TrainingManager365 for workforce readiness and compliance training. Comply365 helps regulated operators shorten document change cycles, maintain regulatory compliance, and connect frontline teams to the current, approved content they need. The company is an Insight Partners portfolio company and is an ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified organization.

providers.name: DocSend
providers.description: DocSend is a secure document sharing and analytics platform, now part of Dropbox, used by sales, marketing, and fundraising teams to share pitch decks, sales collateral, and confidential documents through trackable links. It provides page-by-page viewer analytics, granular access controls (email verification, passcodes, expiration, watermarking), virtual data rooms, and e-signature. DocSend was surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures, DCM Ventures, and Uncork Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. Enrichment confirmed a live, OAuth-secured hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at mcp.docsend.com backed by RFC 8414 authorization-server discovery, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591), and PKCE.

providers.name: Document Crunch
providers.description: Document Crunch is an AI risk intelligence platform for the construction industry. Its construction-specific AI, CrunchAI, reads contracts, subcontracts, specifications, and project documents to surface risky clauses, obligations, and flow-downs with cited sources, and its Project Assist capability automates document reviews, drafts submittals and RFIs, and answers document-grounded questions across the project lifecycle from pursuit through closeout. The platform is used by general contractors, subcontractors, and specialty trades to track risk, align teams on standards, and act on contractual exposure. Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, the company is backed by Fifth Wall. This API Evangelist profile is an enriched company lead; Document Crunch does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Eve
providers.description: Eve (branded EveOS) is an AI operating system purpose-built for plaintiff and personal-injury law firms, founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Mateo, California. The platform works alongside attorneys across the entire case lifecycle - intake and lead qualification, document and medical-record review, medical chronology generation, case and risk analysis, damages calculation, and case management - bringing every case, attorney, and dollar into one place. Eve integrates with practice-management systems such as Clio, is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and HIPAA compliant, and is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Menlo Ventures. Eve is a closed SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Issa
providers.description: Issa Compass is a software platform that simplifies Thailand visa applications, operated by Issara Platforms Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) and Issa Systems Co, Ltd. (Bangkok). The platform helps users identify which Thai visa they qualify for and manages the end-to-end application process: a two-minute eligibility questionnaire, document verification and pre-qualification checks, real-time tracking of requirements against thousands of criteria, and a money-back guarantee if a pre-qualified application is rejected. Supported visa types include the Destination Thailand Visa (DTV), Long-Term Resident (LTR), Retirement, Spouse, and Student visas. Issa is a portfolio company of 500 Global. There is no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Orionsec
providers.description: Orionsec (ORION Security) is a data loss prevention (DLP) platform that uses AI-powered, context-aware agents to detect and prevent data exfiltration across endpoints, SaaS, web, cloud, email, on-premises systems, storage, and print. Rather than relying on static policies, ORION analyzes data classification, lineage, identity, environment, and external relationships to cut false positives and deploy in minutes. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and IBM Ventures and maintains a public trust center documenting SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR posture. As of this profile, Orionsec does not publish a public developer API, reference, or documentation surface.

providers.name: SecurityPal
providers.description: SecurityPal AI is a cybersecurity assurance management platform that pairs AI agents with certified human experts to automate security questionnaires, vendor risk assessments (TPRM), audit response preparation, Trust Center management, and broader GRC workflows for regulated industries including healthcare, financial services, technology, and manufacturing. The platform advertises 700+ native integrations (Salesforce, Okta, Jira, Slack, Microsoft Teams, HubSpot, Zendesk, Google Workspace, and more) and offers three service tiers (Basecamp self-serve AI, Summit AI-plus-concierge, and Everest fully managed). SecurityPal is a Craft Ventures portfolio company. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, domain-security posture, and Trust Center.

providers.name: Xpedeon
providers.description: Xpedeon is a construction-specific ERP platform from Algorithms Software Pvt Ltd (30+ years in construction software), serving general contractors, specialist contractors, housebuilders and developers, engineer-to-order manufacturers, and off-site manufacturers across the UK, India, the GCC, and the US. The cloud platform covers construction finance and accounting, job costing and CVR, contract and subcontractor management, procurement, inventory and supply chain, plant and equipment, warehouse management, HR and payroll, CRM, and a mobile app for site teams, and is ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701 and SOC 2 certified. Xpedeon publishes no public API, developer portal, or integration documentation, but does publish an llms.txt. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Player's Health
providers.description: Player's Health is an insurance and athlete-safety technology company founded in 2016 and based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, serving youth sports organizations, fitness facilities, schools, and collegiate athletic programs. The platform combines specialty insurance products (general liability, sexual abuse and molestation liability, accident medical, directors and officers, equipment and property, cyber, and employee benefits) with athlete-safety and risk-management tooling including coach credentialing and background checks, injury and incident reporting, investigations, mental-health support, and training. Player's Health operates login-gated web portals for claims, certificates of insurance, and safety/compliance (SafetyHub) rather than a public developer API. It is a Techstars-backed company surfaced through the API Evangelist network and profiled here for discovery.

providers.name: Prax Health
providers.description: Prax Health is a healthcare platform that helps nurse practitioners launch and grow their own independent practices. It provides an all-in-one back office that handles business formation, regulatory and clinical compliance, medical billing, insurance credentialing, an integrated EHR, and ongoing practice consulting. The company's stated mission is to put healthcare back in the hands of providers by removing the administrative and operational burden that keeps clinicians from practicing independently. Prax Health is a venture-backed company (Canaan Partners) and operates a consumer/clinician web application rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it exposes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Actualyze AI
providers.description: Actualyze AI is an enterprise AI governance and management company building tools that give organizations the visibility and control they need to adopt AI at scale without slowing their teams down. Founded by Rafi Khardalian (CEO) and Sean Lynch (CTO) — veterans of building and operating distributed systems at global scale — the company designs for regulated industries from day one, embedding compliance, defense-in-depth data protection, comprehensive audit logging, and continuous monitoring into the platform rather than bolting it on. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clerky
providers.description: Clerky is an online legal service that helps startup founders handle their legal paperwork safely and efficiently. Designed by startup attorneys formerly at a Silicon Valley law firm, Clerky provides software and guided workflows for Delaware incorporation and post-incorporation setup, fundraising (SAFEs, convertible notes, board consents), hiring (offer letters, consulting agreements, equity compensation), commercial documents (NDAs), and ongoing corporate maintenance. Clerky is a Y Combinator portfolio company. It is a legal document assistant rather than a law firm, and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic integrations.

providers.name: Cryptio
providers.description: Cryptio is an enterprise-grade crypto accounting, reporting, and audit platform that provides an institutional system of record for digital assets. It ingests and normalizes transaction data across 150+ blockchains, exchanges, custodians, and DeFi protocols, then automates sub-ledger accounting, cost-basis and gain/loss calculation, reconciliation, tokenization compliance, and loan management. Cryptio syncs into traditional ERP and accounting systems (NetSuite, Xero, QuickBooks, Dynamics 365, Oracle Fusion, SAP, Sage) and is used by 400+ institutions including exchanges, banks, asset managers, and DeFi enterprises to produce audit-ready financial reporting for digital assets.

providers.name: Duna
providers.description: Duna is an AI-native business identity platform for KYB (Know Your Business), KYC (Know Your Customer), AML (Anti-Money Laundering), and lifecycle compliance. It accelerates enterprise business onboarding by turning compliance policy into auditable code via a policy engine, using AI agents for document verification and periodic reviews, with deep localization across 210+ business registries and 7+ languages. Duna serves fintechs, banks, and platforms including Plaid, Moss, and Bol, and is backed by Index Ventures. Note: docs.duna.com is password-protected, so no public API reference, OpenAPI, or developer portal was available at enrichment time.

providers.name: Herbie, Herbie Plan
providers.description: Herbie is an AI-powered estate planning platform and law firm that lets individuals and partner organizations create wills, trusts, and related legal documents online. Its agentic engine encodes the principles, laws, and practice of estate planning into a system that drafts and assembles documents at scale, paired with an AI copilot for natural-language guidance and optional attorney review through Herbie Legal. Herbie is offered directly to consumers and as an embeddable "estate planning as a service" offering for wealth management firms, insurance companies, and employers. Herbie was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Immigram LTD
providers.description: Immigram is a UK relocation and immigration platform that helps IT specialists, engineers, founders, and entrepreneurs move to the United Kingdom, primarily via the Global Talent Visa (Tech Nation endorsement route) as well as Skilled Worker, settlement (ILR/naturalization), family, US O-1, and Spanish Startup visa paths. The company pairs immigration legal expertise with an AI-assisted platform that scores eligibility in advance, collects and reviews applicant data into a case, and tracks the process through a live dashboard with data-driven guidance and support. Founded in 2019 and backed by the 500 Global accelerator, Immigram is a services/SaaS provider and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Jobbatical
providers.description: Jobbatical is a global mobility and immigration platform that helps companies manage international employee relocations, work visas, residence permits, and cross-border compliance across 45+ countries. It combines AI-powered case automation with expert immigration support to streamline eligibility assessments, visa and permit applications, renewal tracking, and settlement services for HR and mobility teams. The product centralizes case management, document processing, visa form automation, real-time status tracking, and renewal alerts, and offers pay-as-you-go or pre-purchased credit (FlexyPocket) pricing. Backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: JusticeText
providers.description: JusticeText is an AI-powered discovery and evidence-review platform built for public defenders and criminal defense attorneys. It transcribes and translates audio and video evidence (body-worn camera, dashcam, jail calls, and courtroom proceedings) in more than 100 languages, syncs multiple camera angles into unified timelines, generates AI summaries of lengthy materials, and produces court-ready exhibits with clipping, redaction, and closed captioning. Its MirandaAI assistant surfaces connections across discovery, builds timelines, and flags inconsistencies. JusticeText is backed by 500 Global and Bloomberg Beta. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; JusticeText ships a web application but does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: NexMind
providers.description: NexMind (operating as NexLaw) is a legal AI platform for U.S. litigators and law firms, offering secure, hallucination-free AI that drafts, summarizes, and researches legal work up to 10x faster. Its products include NeXa (AI legal research and drafting assistant), ChronoVault (evidence centralization and automated case timelines), TrialPrep (trial preparation workspace for arguments and witness outlines), and a real-time Courtroom Assistant, with capabilities spanning citation-backed legal deep research, deposition and document analysis, case chronology building, legal memo drafting, and contract and breach analysis. NexLaw is a direct-to-user SaaS product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Simbel
providers.description: Simbel is a Paris-based HR technology company (founded 2021, backed by Speedinvest) offering a smart, unified training management suite that combines a Training Management System (TMS) and a Learning Management System (LMS) in one platform. It helps HR and L&D teams automate the full training lifecycle, from need assessment and request approvals through session organization, e-learning delivery, real-time reporting, and legal compliance (BPF, Qualiopi, BDES). Simbel connects to major HRIS and learning tools such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Lucca, Payfit, BambooHR, 360Learning, and Docebo through pre-built integrations. As of this enrichment pass Simbel publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connectors rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: ZenBusiness
providers.description: ZenBusiness is a business formation and compliance platform that helps entrepreneurs start, run, and grow their companies. It offers LLC and corporation formation, registered-agent service, annual-report and compliance management, EIN/tax filing, business banking and bookkeeping, domain registration, and website building, alongside an AI business guide called Velo. ZenBusiness is a direct-to-consumer/SMB service with no publicly documented developer API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ClassWallet
providers.description: ClassWallet is a patented digital wallet and public-funds disbursement platform used by government agencies, school districts, and program administrators to distribute, control, and reconcile public money. Recipients access and spend allocated funds online or in-store while administrators get spending controls, approved marketplaces, reimbursement workflows, direct vendor payments (DirectPay), and audit-ready reporting and compliance. ClassWallet powers K-12 education programs, Education Savings Accounts (ESAs), scholarships and grants, government assistance, and vocational rehabilitation initiatives. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes product and program surfaces but no public developer API or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: DataGrail
providers.description: DataGrail is a San Francisco-based data privacy platform founded in 2018 by Daniel Barber and Ignacio Zendejas that helps enterprises automate privacy operations and manage regulatory compliance risk across GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regimes. The platform combines a Live Data Map for real-time visibility into where personal data lives across an organization's SaaS and cloud footprint, a Request Manager for orchestrating Data Subject Requests (access, deletion, opt-out) across thousands of downstream systems, a Consent solution for cookie and tracker compliance with automated enforcement, a Risk Management module for privacy and AI risk assessments (PIA, DPIA, AI risk), and an embedded agentic AI named Vera that surfaces context-aware recommendations across the platform. DataGrail exposes a documented public REST API at /api/v2 covering authentication, assessments, privacy requests, opt-out requests, integrations, webhooks, integration files, and consent audit logs, alongside an open-source ecosystem on GitHub that includes mobile Consent SDKs for iOS and Android, a Google Tag Manager consent template, and a Terraform AWS ECS module for deploying Request Manager Agents. The company serves enterprise customers including Salesforce, HubSpot, Okta, Netgear, and Dexcom, advertises 2,000+ pre-built integrations across CRM, marketing, communications, HR, data, e-commerce, and support platforms, holds patents on its Live Data Map and Smart Verification technology, is SOC 2 and ISO certified, and is backed by Felicis Ventures, HubSpot Ventures, Okta Ventures, Basis Set Ventures, Cloud Apps Capital, Operator Collective, Thomson Reuters Ventures, and Third Point Ventures.

providers.name: LawTrades
providers.description: LawTrades is a legal talent marketplace, founded in 2016, that matches companies with vetted independent attorneys, paralegals, and legal operations professionals on flexible, on-demand terms rather than through traditional law firms or ALSPs. The platform covers eleven practice areas — commercial contracts, corporate law, data privacy and cyber security, intellectual property, labor and employment, legal operations, litigation, M&A, product counsel, real estate, and regulatory compliance — and handles matching, work-log management, invoicing, payments, and real-time spend analytics in-product. A human-in-the-loop AI layer drafts documents and flags risk for lawyer review. LawTrades raised a $6M Series A backed by 500 Global, Draper Associates, Social Capital, and AngelList. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Manifest Law
providers.description: Manifest Law operates ManifestOS, a communication and case management platform for the legal industry, and is backed by Menlo Ventures. The platform exposes a standards-based OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect authorization server at app.manifestlaw.com, with an `api` scope for programmatic access and dynamic OAuth client management (`oauth_clients:manage`). This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Manifest Law's public discovery documents; no OpenAPI specification was published at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Model ML
providers.description: Model ML is an AI-native platform for financial services that embeds an agentic "finance agent" into the tools professionals already use — Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, its own app, and a firm's internal systems. It automates deliverables through Workflows, runs compound-intelligence analysis via Grids, performs document review and risk assessment, captures information with a Notetaker, and answers questions through Chat and agentic dashboards backed by real-time data connections. It targets investment banking, consulting, private equity and credit, and asset and wealth management. Model ML is a fintech company backed by QED Investors. The company publishes a trust center and a security program (ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR) but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Red Points
providers.description: Red Points operates an AI-powered brand protection and anti-counterfeiting platform used by businesses to detect and remove counterfeits, unauthorized sellers, fake websites, social media impersonation, and digital piracy across more than 5,000 marketplaces, social networks, and app stores. Its software combines automated detection with enforcement and takedown workflows, domain monitoring, gray-market and unauthorized-seller blocking, ad-fraud detection, and revenue-recovery and litigation services. Red Points was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network; it does not expose a public developer API or documented API surface as of this enrichment pass, so this profile captures the company's public web, legal, security, and llms.txt footprint rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Simpleclosure
providers.description: SimpleClosure is a business-dissolution and wind-down platform for founders, startups, and business owners, positioning itself as "the shutdown standard." It guides a company through the full closure process end to end - from the first decision to wind down through the final state and federal filings - covering entity dissolution (Delaware corporations, LLCs, S-corps), final tax returns, creditor and vendor notifications, asset liquidation, distributions to stakeholders, and compliance obligations. The company offers software plus expert handling, with tailored solutions for lawyers, investors, and financial services firms managing portfolio-company or client wind-downs. SimpleClosure was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list and operates a customer application at app.simpleclosure.com. It is a services-and-software company rather than a developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface.

providers.name: User1st
providers.description: User1st is a web and mobile digital accessibility company whose U1 Suite gives organizations an efficient path to WCAG, ADA, and European Accessibility Act (EAA) compliance. It provides accessibility toolkits and remediation across web frameworks (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, WordPress, Shopify) and mobile platforms (iOS Native, Android Native, React Native, Flutter), plus a free accessibility scanner and GenAI-assisted code-fixing and image-description tooling. Trusted by organizations including Amtrak, Fannie Mae, IKEA, iRobot, T-Mobile, Santander, Mount Sinai, and the City of New York. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the product backend is an internal SaaS API with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: BrightInsight
providers.description: BrightInsight is a regulated digital health platform for biopharma and medtech. Its cloud-based, microservices platform captures, transmits and analyzes data from CE-marked and FDA-regulated medical devices, combination products, apps and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) in compliance with global security, privacy and regulatory requirements. The platform integrates with 400+ medical devices across 50+ manufacturers, connects to EHRs in 500+ U.S. provider networks, and is available in 48 countries. Founded in 2017 (formerly Flex Digital Health) and based in Alviso, California, BrightInsight is used by top biopharma and medtech companies to build and launch commercial regulated digital health solutions. It is a sales-led enterprise platform with no public developer portal or public API; integration is delivered under managed engagements.

providers.name: Certa
providers.description: Certa (operated by Opinr, Inc. d/b/a Certa) is an AI-native third-party risk management (TPRM) and compliance platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle — onboarding, due diligence, contract management, continuous compliance monitoring, and offboarding — in a single no-code system. Founded by Jag Lamba and headquartered in Saratoga, CA, Certa serves Fortune 500 companies (Honeywell, Uber, Mars, Box, Quantcast) across 120+ countries and 17 languages. The platform covers all risk domains — operational and resilience, infosec and cyber, compliance and legal, financial and credit, reputational, geopolitical, and ESG and ethical risk — via its Studio no-code process designer, Certa Connect (130+ native integrations), and embedded AI agents. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools. External integration is available through an enterprise external API surfaced from the platform; no public OpenAPI or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Deepjudge
